general_add_friend_details: Add this player to your friends list.
general_remove_friend_details: Remove this player from your friends list.
general_error_sea_deny: SEA Users must connect via the Garena client.
general_error_sea_message1: The Heroes of Newerth beta for users in Singapore, Malaysia, Vietnam and the Philippines will be starting soon.  At the start of closed beta, gamers from these countries will be able to redeem a Beta Key immediately if they are Garena Gold Members, while other keys are given away in other community efforts. Please note that countries not stated here (e.g. Indonesia, Thailand) will be unable to play on Garena servers, and would require purchasing a paid account to enjoy the game in Frostburn Studios' international servers.
general_error_sea_message2: For more updates from the Garena Team regarding their Heroes of Newerth release, visit their blog at ^yhttp://blog.garena.com^* or the official Garena Heroes of Newerth website at ^yhttp://hon.garena.com^*.
general_mode_all_pick_desc: All heroes a player has access to are available to be picked.
general_mode_random_draft_desc: Limits hero selection to 20 heroes then alternates picking between players.
general_mode_allrandom_desc: All players are given a random hero they have access to with a balanced team composition. All players start the match with more gold.
general_mode_balancedrandom: Balanced Random (now melded into the original All Random)
general_mode_balancedrandom_desc: All players are given a random hero they have access to. All players start the match with more gold.
general_mode_blindban_desc: Players begin with the full pool of heroes. Each player bans 1 hero of their choice before the picking phase starts.  After the banning phase ends, players can choose from the remaining heroes simultaneously.
general_mode_blindbanningpick_desc: Players begin with the full pool of heroes. Three heroes are then banned by the players in the Blue and Pink positions simultaneously without the other team knowing which heroes the other team chose to ban. Players are then shown the bans and are all given the ability to choose from the remaining heroes simultaneously.
general_mode_blindbanningpickblitz_desc: Players begin with the full pool of heroes. Three heroes are then banned by the players in the Blue and Pink positions simultaneously without the other team knowing which heroes the other team chose to ban. Players are then shown the bans and are all given the ability to choose from the remaining heroes simultaneously. Players have lower cooldowns and manacost, but higher regeneration rates!
general_mode_banningdraftblitz_desc: Players begin with a pool of 24 heroes. The Blue and Pink players then alternate banning 2 heroes each. After the banning, players take turns choosing their heroes from the remaining pool. Players have lower cooldowns and manacost, but higher regeneration rates!
general_mode_banningpick_desc: Players begin with the full pool of heroes. The Blue and Pink players then alternate banning 4 heroes each. After the banning, players take turns choosing their heroes from the remaining pool.
general_mode_lockpick_desc: Lock Pick requires that you have a full group of 5 players.   Group leaders are the captains of the team and do all of the banning, locking, and picking for the team.   Players begin with the full pool of heroes. Two heroes are then blind banned by each captain.   After blind banning, captains alternate locking 6 heroes into the lock pool to be chosen from by both teams later.   Captains then alternate banning 3 heroes each from the remaining pool.   After banning, the captains alternate picking heroes from the remaining hero pool for the first 3 players on each team. Finally, the captains alternate picking heroes from the locked pool for the remaining 2 players on each team.
general_mode_lockpick_desc_short: Lock Pick is the official game type for competitive play. Lock Pick games require a full group of 5 players and may only be played on the Forests of Caldavar map. The group leader will be made the team captain.
general_mode_lockpick_desc_short2: Unselecting the Competitive Mode option below will allow you to play additional game modes.
general_mode_captainsmode_desc: Group leaders are the captains of the team and do all of the banning and picking for the team.
general_mode_krosmode_desc: Players pick a hero, and then heroes whose abilities will be added to a pool. Then, your abilities are randomly selected out of that pool each time you spawn.
general_mode_gated_desc: Players choose from a crafted pool of 40 heroes.
general_mode_dupe_hero_desc: Multiple players can pick the same hero.
general_mode_force_pick_desc: Everyone is forced to pick a specific hero.
general_mode_soccer_pick_desc: Hero Selection is restricted to mode-specific heroes
general_mode_solo_same_desc: Players select three heroes each. Each player then bans two of the opponent's heroes.  You will then receive a random hero of the two remaining ones and both players go in-game with the same hero.
general_mode_solo_diff_desc: Players select three heroes each. Each player then bans two of the opponent's heroes.  You will then receive your remaining hero out of your pool of three.
general_mode_herobanpick_desc: Players begin with the full pool of heroes. Each player bans 1 hero of their choice before the picking phase starts. No duplicate bans can be made.  After the banning phase ends, players can choose from the remaining heroes simultaneously.
general_mode_midwars_beta_desc: Modifies Mid Wars in a fun and exciting way!
general_mode_blitz_desc: Players have lower cooldowns and manacost, but higher regeneration rates!
general_mode_tournament_dec: Competitive mode requires that you have a full group of 5 players. These games can only be played on Normal Forests of Caldavar using the Lock Pick game mode.
general_mode_singledraft_desc: Each player is given a hero selection of one agility, one intelligence, and one strength hero.
general_mode_banningdraft_desc: Players begin with a pool of 24 heroes. The Blue and Pink players then alternate banning 2 heroes each. After the banning, players take turns choosing their heroes from the remaining pool.
general_mode_counterpick_desc: Teams alternate between selecting heroes one at a time.
general_mode_reborn_desc: Each team votes for bans. Afterwards, teams share turns picking heroes; any player on the team can pick a hero.

main_optimal_settings_prompt_body: We've detected that you may have better performance with lower settings, and have automatically changed your settings.  Would you like to keep these settings, or revert to previous settings?
main_peel_2_tip_body: View the status of players you have referred and earn the exclusive Professor Repulsor avatar!
main_label_login_garena: You must launch Heroes of Newerth through the Garena Messenger.
main_label_login_ntreev: You must launch Heroes of Newerth through Ntreev.
main_label_login_axeso5: You must launch Heroes of Newerth through Axeso5.
main_quit_confirm2: Are you sure you want to exit HoN?
main_label_update_avail: A newer version of HoN is available for download! Would you like to download this version now?
main_login_save_username_tip: When selected, your username will be saved and automatically entered when you start the game.
main_login_auto_auth_tip: When selected, your password will be saved and you will be automatically logged in when you start the game.
main_login_invis_mode_tip: When selected, your friends and clan mates will not be notified when you sign on/off or join/leave games, but you will still receive their notifications.
main_graphicsdriverold_confirm2: The driver of your graphics card is too old! Please Update it.
main_login_holiday_sale_body: Make sure to head to Merrick's shop and claim your FREE holiday presents (Christmas Tree and Manora Ward Skins along with Jollywood and Christmas Keeper) from the HoN Team. Act quickly though, they are only available from Dec.17th until Jan. 2nd!
main_login_queue_body: You've been placed into a login queue.  You'll need to wait for others to login first.
confirm_lang_desc: You must restart HoN for your language changes to properly take effect.
confirm_lang_desc_new: In order to change your language, you must restart HoN.
confirm_disconnect_msg: Are you sure you want to disconnect from this game?
confirm_leaver_result_nowleaver: You will NOT be able to join leaver protected games if you disconnect from this game.
confirm_leaver_result_notleaver: You will NOT become a leaver if you disconnect from this game.
confirm_switchsub_msg: Are you sure you want to switch accounts?
confirm_verify_text1: Your Verified account allows you to exclude Basic accounts when you play matchmaking games.
confirm_verify_text2: Excluding Basic accounts will increase your chances of finding a game free of griefers and smurf accounts.
confirm_verify_text3: As a reward for becoming verified, you have received 5 free Tokens. Tokens can be used to play special game modes and play heroes that you do not own.
confirm_verify_bene_what: What are the benefits of a Verified Account?
confirm_verify_bene_txt1: You are currently logged in with a Basic account. You are able to play unlimited games with a Basic account, but there are some perks to being Verified:
confirm_verify_bene_txt2: You will be able to choose to play with only other Verified Users, you can buy tokens and passes to play other game modes, and you can use the Report a Player feature.
confirm_verify_bene_txt3: Converting your Basic account into a Verified account is simple. Simply perform ONE of the following tasks:
confirm_verify_bene_opt1_txt1: You can earn a Verified account for free by simply playing more Matchmaking games! Once you reach the target level, your account will automatically become Verified.
confirm_verify_bene_opt2_txt1: To instantly convert to a Verified account, you can make a purchase of any Goblin Coin package.
account_lost_username_msg: Enter the email address attached to your account below to have your username sent to you.
account_lost_username_success: An email containing your username has been sent to the email address attached to your account.
account_lost_username_error1: I'm an error. Look at me. Justin will be making real errors some day!  No I won't!  I don't need your steenking errors!
account_lost_password_msg: Enter either your username or email address to have your password sent to the email address attached to your account.
account_lost_password_success: An email containing your password has been sent to the email address attached to your account.
cp_string_2: Your password has expired or is set to expire soon!
cp_string_3: Once your password has expired you will no longer be able to play Heroes of Newerth until you change it. Please choose a new password now to avoid any gameplay interruptions.
cp_string_4: ^yNote:^* You cannot reuse your old password, and your new password must be at least six characters long.
main_reconnect_text: You have disconnected from a game in progress, and may re-join that game.
main_reconnect_playing_in: You are playing in a game under progress:
main_leavegroup_body: In order to continue you must leave any current games and groups. Would you like to continue?
main_filter_prequery_tip: Selecting this option will filter the game list based on the ^!yRegion^* you have selected server side, instead of client side. This decreases the amount of time needed to retrieve and ping the list of games. Using this option should help if you have a slower connection.
main_filter_hide_restricted_tip: Selecting this option will hide all games that are restricted to you due to having a "Leaver" status or having a PSR that does not fall into the Min/Max PSR range the host specified.
main_leaver_tip: Your leaver status indicates if you are able to join Leaver Restricted games. The number of leaves allowed is determined by games played.
map_loading_capturetheflag_tip01: - Right-click the enemy flag to pick it up. You cannot pick up your own flag.
map_loading_capturetheflag_tip02: - Capture the enemy flag by carrying it to your flag in your base.
map_loading_capturetheflag_tip03: - Carrying the enemy flag or standing in a well incurs significant damage increase.
map_loading_capturetheflag_tip05: - Drop the enemy flag by hitting I (default) or clicking this icon:
map_loading_team_deathmatch_tip01: - Team deathmatch is a series of 5v5 teamfights in an arena setting!
map_loading_team_deathmatch_tip02: - Players have time to prepare before a round starts. Each hero is given a set amount of XP & Gold per round. Players cannot gain XP or Gold except from this mechanic.
map_loading_team_deathmatch_tip03: - Once a round begins, teams will fight to the death! Don't stall too long, or you'll get Revealed & Burned!
map_loading_team_deathmatch_tip04: - There will be up to 7 rounds per game. Win as many rounds as possible while minimizing ally casualties.
map_loading_team_deathmatch_tip05: - The first team to reach 18 points or has the most points by the end of Round 7 will win the match!
map_loading_devowars_tip02: - Hooks bounce off walls and curve with Devourer.
map_loading_devowars_tip03: - Hook an Enemy Devourer while he is already hooked for an ^rInstant Kill^*!
map_loading_devowars_tip04: - Purchase Upgrades for Hook and other various items at the shop.
map_loading_devowars_tip05: - Runes spawn every^719 20^* seconds at a random side of the river, obtained by hooking.
map_loading_devowars_tip06: - First team to achieve 60 kills wins!
map_loading_grimmscrossing_tip01: - On this map there are less towers, only two lanes, and only one rune location.
map_loading_grimmscrossing_tip02: - Two statues exist in the middle of the map, clicking one will teleport you to the other.
map_loading_grimmscrossing_tip03: - Killing the boss, General Atrox, decreases enemy Tower armor and drops Bananas.
map_loading_grimmscrossing_tip04: - Enemy buildings also have reduced Armor while enemy heroes are dead.
map_loading_grimmscrossing_tip05: - First team to destroy the enemy team's base wins!
map_loading_caldavar_tip01: - Power up your hero through items and levels and destroy the enemy base to win!
map_loading_caldavar_tip02: - Defeating a Kongor boss will grant permanent buffs. Defeating 2 within a short time will grant you Token of Life & a siege bonus.
map_loading_caldavar_tip03: - Destroying an enemy Barracks will empower your creeps.
map_loading_caldavar_tip04: - Always keep a Homecoming Stone handy, they're essential to moving around the map quickly.
map_loading_caldavar_tip05: - Killing enemy towers grants gold for your team and reduces enemy mobility.
map_loading_midwars_tip01: - Midwars features rapidly accelerated gold, experience and respawn timers. First team to destroy the enemy team's base wins!
map_loading_midwars_tip02: - Killing the bosses will grant a player the effects of all runes.
map_loading_riftwars_tip01: - Pick one hero to play and two others after, shuffling all of their abilities.
map_loading_riftwars_tip02: - Every time you respawn, you get four new random abilities!
map_loading_riftwars_tip03: - Killing your enemy causes them to lose points, granting you a huge advantage when they have none left.
map_loading_riftwars_tip04: - Respawn time is vastly reduced and you don't lose gold on death.
map_loading_riftwars_tip05: - Win the game by destroying their base or killing all of them when they have 0 points left.
map_loading_soccer_tip01: - Each hero has a Kick/Slide and Sprint ability as well as 3 unique abilities
map_loading_soccer_tip02: - Walk or Slide over the ball to pick it up
map_loading_soccer_tip03: - When a hero is reduced to 0 life, they are Knocked Out, and cannot act for a duration
map_loading_soccer_tip04: - Kicking or walking the ball into the enemy's goal earns a point
map_loading_solomap_tip02: - Kill the enemy hero or outer tower to achieve victory.
map_loading_solomap_tip03: - If no hero or tower kill has occurred after 15 minutes the player with the most creep kills wins, if tied creep denies are used.
map_loading_solomap_tip04: - Creeps spawn only in the middle lane and all other lanes are turned off.
map_loading_solomap_tip05: - There are no neutrals or runes in this mode.
map_loading_caldavar_reborn_tip01: - Power up your hero through items and levels and destroy the enemy base to win!
map_loading_caldavar_reborn_tip02: - Defeating Kongor will grant your team permanent buffs!
map_loading_caldavar_reborn_tip03: - Destroying an enemy Barracks will empower your creeps.
map_loading_caldavar_reborn_tip04: - Always keep a Homecoming Stone handy, they're essential to moving around the map quickly.
map_loading_caldavar_reborn_tip05: - Killing enemy towers grants gold for your team and reduces enemy mobility.
options_repair_confirm_desc: Are you sure you want to try to repair your installation? You will be disconnected and the client will automatically restart.
options_display_tip: The display to use when running the game in fullscreen mode.
options_resolution_tip: The number of pixels displayed across and down your display.
options_color_depth_tip: The number of bits per pixel. Some lower end systems can see a performance boost by selecting 16bit color depth.
options_tip_refresh_rate: How many times per second your display is updated. Higher values prevent flickering, but may not be supported at higher resolutions.
options_label_anti_aliasing_tip: Anti-Aliasing smoothes multi samples of scenes giving the image a softer, more realistic look on the edges of models. The more samples you use, the slower the game may run.
options_label_aspect_ratio_tip: Relative horizontal and vertical display size. If you are using a LCD monitor, make sure you select the resolution native to your monitor to ensure a crisp image.
options_label_texture_filtering_tip: Smoothes out textures as they change their distance or angle from the camera. No filtration is the fastest, but allows for pixelation while Anisotropic is the most accurate, but may cause a decrease in performance on lower end systems.
options_brightness_tip: Increase brightness by dragging the slider to the right, decrease it by sliding to the left. Default setting is 1.00
options_full_screen_tip: The game will fill your entire screen.
options_checkbox_show_client_info_tip: Displays current FPS and Ping at the top right of the screen.
options_exclusive_mode_tip: Running in Exclusive mode may increase performance slightly, but make multitasking more difficult.
options_frame_queuing_tip: Enabling Frame Queuing may increase performance but can also increase input latency.
options_model_quality_tip: Using less complex model vertexes will allow the game to run smoother on lower end systems and video cards.
options_texture_size_tip: Using larger textures will result in better visual detail at the cost of both video and physical memory.
options_shader_water_quality_tip: Water quality. Lowering the quality will hinder visuals, but allow the game to run on lower end video cards.
options_shader_quality_tip: Shaders require a lot of horsepower from your graphics processor. Lowering the quality will hinder visuals, but allow the game to run on lower end video cards.
options_shadow_quality_tip: The higher the shadow quality, the crisper shadows will appear, but at the cost of additional video memory. Shadows are limited by both your graphics processor and CPU.
options_special_effects_tip: Special effects are used in unit abilities and similar animations. Use of lower quality decreases particle count and allows the game to run smoother on lower end systems.
options_reflections_tip: Reflections are used in objects like armor and water to show real-time reflections at the expense of performance.
options_rim_lighting_tip: Rim Lighting enhances the visual contrast of models against the background by simulating the effects of a bright light behind the model, creating a bright rim around the upper edges.
options_refraction_tip: Refraction allows for higher end special effects using scene warping at the expense of performance.
options_post_processing_tip: Enable Post Processing effects at the expense of performance.
options_spec_fog_tip: Renders fog when viewing a game as a spectator.
options_spec_skybox_tip: Renders the skybox when viewing a game as a spectator.
options_foliage_tip_text: Turning off foliage will increase your video performance.
options_skybox_tip_text: Turning on/off the skybox will change the visuals of reflections.
options_d3dex_tip_text: Reduces the amount of memory used by DirectX. In the event of driver failure, recovery will take longer than usual. Window Vista and Windows 7 Only.
options_vsync_tip_text: If your frame rate is consistently higher than your refresh rate, vertical sync can improve image quality. Vertical sync may decrease your frame rate, especially on older video cards.
options_checkbox_transparency_aa_desc: Transparency Anti-Aliasing is a method to smooth transparent texture edges, as opposed to model edges, to create a softer look. These types of textures are most often used as foliage. Increasing the sampling will make certain textures smoother but may hinder performance.
options_dynamic_lights_tip: Dynamic lights are used to enhance effects and the look of the game, but can decrease performance on some video cards.
options_graphicslvl_txt1: Use the slider to the left to set your graphics options.
options_graphicslvl_txt2: After changing your setting, click the Apply button to view the effects of the changes in the sample scene. Setting a new graphics level will overwrite some of the options you may have set below.
options_graphicslvl_txt3: If you would like more control over specific graphical options, you can scroll down and manually change the options.
options_master_volume_tip: Set the level for all sounds.
options_sound_effects_tip: Set the level for in-game sound effects.
options_interface_volume_tip: Set the level for interface sounds, such as button clicks.
options_sound_output_tip: Select the sound output system to use.
options_sound_quality_tip: Sound Quality can be sacrificed for lower memory usage.
options_sound_channels_tip: Number of sounds that can be simultaneously played.
options_disable_all_sounds_tip: If enabled, the sound system is disabled. Disabling sounds can be beneficial to systems with low amounts of RAM. (Requires a restart)
options_unit_reactions_tip: When unit reactions are enabled, units respond when you click them or give them an action.
options_checkbox_mute_announcer_tip: If enabled, the announcers voice will not be heard.
options_unit_voice_reaction_tip: How much of a delay should occur before playing a unit voice reaction again.
options_checkbox_sound_mute_tip: If enabled, all sounds are muted.
options_checkbox_sound_mutemusic_tip: If enabled, music will be muted, but other sounds will still be heard.
options_checkbox_sound_mutepings_tip: If enabled, announcments caused by pings will not be played but the chat text and map effect will still be shown.
options_checkbox_banjo_sound_tip: If enabled, the throwback Banjo Sound will play upon quitting the HoN client.
options_checkbox_hero_holdaftermove_tip: If enabled, the issued hero will Hold Position after all commands are completed, and will not automatically aggro onto nearby enemy units.
options_oldmaininterface_tip: If enabled, uses the new main interface. Changing this option requires a client restart & may cause gamebreaking bugs if you do not restart.  Old interfaces may create new bugs & remove certain features, and are not officially supported. Bug reports for this will be rejected.
options_useoldshop_tip: If enabled, uses the new shop interface. Changing this option requires a client restart & may cause gamebreaking bugs if you do not restart.  Old interfaces may create new bugs & remove certain features, and are not officially supported. Bug reports for this will be rejected.
options_checkbox_no_switch_to_hidden_her: If enabled and you have control of more than 1 hero unit, pressing the "Select Next Hero" hotkey won't switch to a hero that does not visually appear on the screen.
options_voice_chat_volume_tip: Adjusts the volume of incoming Voice Chat from other players and the volume of Shoutcaster in replaying.
options_mic_volume_tip: Adjusts your microphone's input volume. The higher it is, the louder you will sound to other players.
options_mic_gain_tip: Adjusts the volume of the input recorded from your microphone. The higher it is, the louder you will sound to other players.
options_auto_dampen_tip: When you are using VOIP you can automatically reduce the level of other game sounds. Select your level of dampening by dragging the slider.
options_mic_boost_tip: Boosts microphone volume at the cost of sound quality.
options_disable_voice_chat_tip: Turn voice chat off. You will not hear chat from other players.
options_push_to_talk_enable_tip: When Push To Talk is enabled, your mic will be turned on as long as the hotkey is depressed. If you do not use Push To Talk, your mic will be turned on automatically when you speak.
options_push_to_talk_tip: Holding down this key will turn on your mic if you have Voice Chat enabled.
options_push_to_mentor_talk_tip: Holding down this key will turn on your mic if you have Voice Chat enabled, however, it will only talk to your pupil.
options_push_to_lane_talk_tip: Holding down this key will turn on your mic if you have Voice Chat enabled, however, it will only talk to nearby allies, not everyone on your team.
options_mic_off_time_tip: Your mic will turn off after this amount of time without you saying anything.
options_mic_on_sensitivity_tip: Set the voice strength at which you want your mic to automatically turn on. The red arrow indicates the peak level of a mic level test. It is suggested that your sensitivity level is slightly lower than your peak mic level.
options_camera_scroll_speed_tip: Rate in game units per second at which the camera will move.
options_screen_edge_scroll_tip: If enabled, the camera will move when the mouse cursor is placed at the edge of the screen.
options_screen_camera_lock_tip: If enabled, the camera will move with the hero in-game.
options_autoselect_summonings_tip: If enabled, new summoned unit or illusions will be automatically added to the current selection group.
options_screen_smart_casting_tip: Causes abilities to be used at the location of the cursor without requiring an extra mouse click.
options_constrain_cursor_tip: If enabled, the mouse cursor will be restricted from moving outside of the game window while the game window has focus.
options_display_xp_rewards_tip: If enabled, the game will show when your hero gains experience in-game by drawing purple numbers at the source of the reward.
options_bind_instructions_button: To choose a new bind ^ypress^* a key or mouse button.
options_bind_instructions_impulse: To choose a new bind ^ypress^* a key combination.
options_healthbar_shadows_hero_tip: Shows a shadow bar behind hero health bars to indicate damage taken per hit.  The shadow slowly moves to match the hero's actual health.
options_healthbar_shadows_creep_tip: Shows a shadow bar behind creep health bars to indicate damage taken per hit.  The shadow slowly moves to match the creep's actual health.
options_healthbar_shadows_building_tip: Shows a shadow bar behind building health bars to indicate damage taken per hit.  The shadow slowly moves to match the building's actual health.
options_healthbar_shadows_misc_tip: Shows a shadow bar behind object health bars to indicate damage taken per hit.  The shadow slowly moves to match the object's actual health.  This option covers health bars which aren't included in the Hero, Creep, and Building checkboxes.
options_checkbox_goldlerp_tip: When enabled, your gold count animates to its current value over 350ms.
options_label_primary_keybind_tooltip: The primary button is used to select units, use abilities, and interact with the game interface.
options_label_secondary_keybind_tooltip: The secondary button is used to issue context sensitive commands, such as moving and attacking.
options_label_shiftmod_keybind_tooltip: Shift Modifier allows the user to queue up commands.
options_label_ctrlmod_keybind_tooltip: Ctrl Modifier can be used in conjunction with several other miscellaneous game commands.
options_label_self_cast_keybind_tooltip: Activating this modifier while casting an ability will auto target yourself with the ability.
options_label_mod3_keybind_tooltip: Pressing this button while issuing an order will make a unit attempt the most direct path to their goal.
options_label_center_screen_keybind_tool: Centers camera on primary selection, which is generally the unit you're currently controlling.
options_label_center_info_keybind_toolti: Centers camera on secondary selections, such as other heroes and units.
options_label_user_best_courier_tip: Causes the courier to get your items from your stash and deliver them to you as fast as possible.
tip_text_smartcasting_1: If On Release Smart Cast Type is enabled, the cast will occur when you release the hotkey.  If On Press Smart Cast Type is enabled, the cast will occur when you press the hotkey.
tip_name_smartcasting_2: Set all keys to Normal Cast
tip_text_smartcasting_2: Click to set all abilities and items to Normal Casting.
tip_name_smartcasting_3: Set all keys to Smart Cast
tip_text_smartcasting_3: Click to set all abilities and items to Smart Casting.
tip_text_smartcasting_4: Check the box beneath the ability and inventory slots you would like to set to Smart Cast, or click All Smart Cast to set all abilities and items to Smart Cast.
options_simple_smart_casting_text: Causes abilities to be used at the location of the cursor without requiring an extra mouse click
options_limit_pings_tip: If enabled, only 3 pings to the map will be shown at once. This prevents spamming, but could also limit the amount of useful map pings that can be visible.
options_muteminimappings_voicemutedallie: Mute Minimap Ping from Voice-Muted Allies
If enabled, minimap pings will not be shown or played from voice-muted allies.
options_screen_health_always_on_tip: If enabled, health bars will always be displayed.
options_screen_hide_full_healthbar_trip: IF enabled, full health bars will be hidden for non hero units.
options_screen_hover_hero_info_tip: If enabled, hero info will be displayed when hovering.
options_screen_ground_sprite_tip: If enabled, a sprite will be displayed under heroes to convey team color or player color.
options_screen_death_tip: If enabled, hero specific gameplay tips will be displayed upon your untimely demise.
options_screen_team_or_player_color_tip: Uses Player Specific Colors rather than Team Colors
options_dropdown_minimap_portrait_color_: If enabled, hero portraits will be displayed on the minimap with the border style of your choice: team colors or player-specific colors.
options_checkbox_show_timestamps_tip: If enabled, displays timestamps for in-game chat.
options_checkbox_reverse_minimap_tip: If enabled, the mini map on the game interface is moved from the lower left to the lower right of the screen.
options_checkbox_camera_center_on_respaw: If enabled, the camera will automatically move to your hero's location when your hero respawns.
options_checkbox_cast_indicators_tip: If enabled, abilities will display indicators to aid with targeting.
options_checkbox_cg_toolpersistanttarget: If enabled, cast materials will persist on the target area until your character can begin their cast.
options_screen_popup_damage_tip: If enabled, damage inflicted will be displayed over the enemy.
options_checkbox_aoe_indicators_tip: If enabled, abilities will display team-colored persisting area of effect indicators.
options_checkbox_debuff_popup_tip: If enabled, control imparing effects will popup when your character is afflicted.
options_checkbox_debuff_popup_icon_tip: If enabled, an icon which shows control imparing effects will popup when your character is afflicted.
options_checkbox_minimap_path_tip: If enabled, your hero's movement path will be displayed on the minimap. This is only visible to you.

options_trouble_faq_intro: The frequently asked questions below are displayed to help with the most common issues. For a more extensive FAQ, or to ^ycontact customer support^* directly, please visit ^y{value}^*.
options_trouble_faq1_q: How do I change my password?
options_trouble_faq1_a: Visit ^y{value}^* to update your password on the left.
options_trouble_faq2_q: How can I get a refund on my recent purchase?
options_trouble_faq2_a: Please contact Customer Support directly providing your Transaction ID or Invoice ID.
options_trouble_faq3_q: My graphics are all messed up
options_trouble_faq3_a: Disable any mods you have and restart your client
options_trouble_faq4_q: The match I was in just crashed
options_trouble_faq4_a: Restart Heroes of Newerth and attempt to reconnect
options_trouble_faq4_a2: Manually try reconnect by opening the console (ctrl+f8), typing reconnect, then pressing enter. Close the console to see if you are able to reconnect.
options_trouble_faq4_a3: Wait until the match is over, if all players were disconnected, please contact Customer Service directly.
options_trouble_faq5_q: I cannot update, connect to chat, or join matchmaking
options_trouble_faq5_a: Please disable your firewall and/or antivirus or allow Heroes of Newerth to bypass it
options_trouble_faq5_a2: Allow outgoing traffic to ports TCP:80 (login/update), TCP:11031 (chatserver) and UDP:11235-11335 (game servers)
options_trouble_faq6_a: Make sure all of your drivers are updated to their latest version
options_trouble_faq6_a2: Lower your graphics and/or sound settings
options_trouble_faq6_a3: Do a Repair Install and delete any mods you may have installed in the past

web_form_reportabuse_blurb: Problematic players may be reported to Frostburn for review. Please fill out the form carefully and be as accurate as possible in your description of the incident. Intentional misuse of the Report Abusive Behavior feature may result in your account being suspended.
web_form_reportabuse_type0_desc: Spamming or advertising a service in a game.
web_form_reportabuse_type1_desc: Racially offensive, sexually explicit, or profane nicknames may be reported and recommended for a name change.
web_form_reportabuse_type2_desc: Deliberate and malicious exploitation of bugs to gain an advantage over the enemy team or grief allies. Some examples follow:
web_form_reportabuse_type2_desc3: Intentionally causing the game to crash
web_form_reportabuse_type5_desc: Impersonation of Frostburn Studios employees or volunteer personnel to intimidate or otherwise gain an advantage over other players.
web_form_reportabuse_type6_desc: Manipulation of stats, rating, or game outcome via multi-accounting or plants. Poor playing, unintentional feeding, and other similar incidents are NOT reportable under this or any other rule.
web_form_reportabuse_type7_desc: Discussion of topics that violate US Law.
web_form_reportabuse_type9_desc: Purposeful irritation or harassment of other players whether verbally or through the game contrary to game objectives.  Examples include:
web_form_reportabuse_type9_desc1: Intentional use of items or abilities to grief allies (ie, Nymphora's teleport)
web_form_reportabuse_type9_desc2: Illogical refusal to participate in a match
web_form_reportabuse_type9_desc3: Intentional disruption of a match (ie, calling out allied positions)
web_form_reportabuse_type10_desc: Excessive in-game verbal harassment of another player with the intent to demean or otherwise negatively affect another player.  Examples include:
web_form_reportabuse_type10_desc3: Sexual harassment of gender or identity
web_form_reportabuse_type10_desc5: Intent to threaten an individual in any fashion
report_a_player_abuse_type1_desc2: Attack on your creed, race, gender
report_a_player_abuse_type2_desc2: Denying themselves or allies repeatedly without logical cause
report_a_player_abuse_type3_desc1: Player claimed they are Staff or GM (or know one) and will suspend you
report_a_player_abuse_type3_desc2: Frostburn/GM Members use a ^rRed^* or ^500Maroon^* name color
report_a_player_abuse_type4_desc2: Using abilities or items to harm allies intentionally
report_a_player_abuse_type4_desc3: Selling or spam purchasing items to harm the team or waste gold
report_a_player_abuse_type5_desc1: Complete and constant refusal to assist allies, particularly in defending structures
report_a_player_abuse_type5_desc2: Purposeful removal of AFK detection timer via movement, spell/item use, or self damage
report_a_player_abuse_type6_desc2: English profanity or obvious bypass thereof
report_a_player_abuse_type6_desc3: Promotion of globally or historically significant societal injustices or catastrophes
report_a_player_abuse_type6_desc4: Imitation or mockery of Staff Members

game_label_stash_tool_tip: The Stash is used to store items when your inventory is full. Items purchased from the shop when you are away from base will automatically be placed in your stash.  Left-clicking on an auto-forming item in your stash will disassemble it.

game_shop_label_total_cost_tip: The total cost of a recipe includes both the recipe cost and the cost of the component items required to complete the recipe. Using this button will attempt to purchase all items required for this recipe, placing any items you can purchase either in your inventory or in your stash.
game_shop_label_shoptip_summary: The Shop has two main categories, items and recipes. Items are the individual components that are used to create recipes. Some recipes require you to purchase an actual recipe item after buying its components in order to complete the recipe, while others will form automatically once you have the required components.  If you accidentally purchase an item, you have a 15 second grace period in which you can sell it back for a full refund.
game_shop_label_shoptip_features: To view what recipes an item is used in, hold ^gSHIFT^* and ^gLEFT CLICK^* on that item.  To move an item from your inventory to your stash or from your stash to your inventory, hold ^gCTRL^* and ^gRIGHT CLICK^* on it.  To sell an item, either pick it up with ^gRIGHT CLICK^* then drop it on the shop interface with ^gLEFT CLICK^*, or hold ^gCTRL^* and ^gSHIFT^* then ^gRIGHT CLICK^* on it.

mm_pregression_key_explanation: The Matchmaking Endgame Progression system allows players to earn both Experience and Silver Goblin Coins to be used in the store by playing in Matchmaking games. Silver Coins are earned in the following three ways during games: Game Performance, Aggregate Account Stats, and Account Leveling.
mm_pregression_key_consecbonus_exp: ^y*Consecutive Bonus^* is earned by playing a new match within 15 minutes of a match concluding. Each consecutive win is worth 1 coin equal to the number of consecutive games, up to a max of 6. Losses are always worth 1 coin.
mm_pregression_key_consecbonus_exp3: For your first consecutive match you win and receive 1 coin. You have two losses, each earning 1 coin. The fourth match is a win, and earns you 4 coins. The bonus caps at a maximum of 6 per win.  Early disconnections from a match forfeits the accumulated bonus.
match_awards_ctfdistance_m_desc: You know the first marathon runner died at the end, right? Traveled farthest with the flag.
match_awards_ctfcarrierdamage_l_desc: It seems you know that "flag" also means "wilt." Dealt the least damage to flag carriers.
match_awards_ctfcarrierdamage_m_desc: That flag was just a bullseye to you. Dealt the most damage to flag carriers.
match_awards_ctfcaptures_m_desc: Your flag collection is legendary. Had the most flag captures.
match_awards_ctfreturns_m_desc: Time for a treat! Had the most flag returns.
match_awards_ctfdeaths_m_desc: We mourn your sacrifices...all of them...yikes. Had the most deaths.
match_awards_soccergoals_m_desc: Scored the most goals. Way to bend it like Breaky!
match_awards_soccergoalassists_m_desc: Had the most assists. Thanks for spreading the love!
match_awards_soccersteals_m_desc: Had the most steals, which takes a lot of balls.
match_awards_soccerknockouts_m_desc: Had the most opponent Knock Outs. So much for friendlies!
match_awards_soccertimewithballs_m_desc: Traveled the longest with the ball. Dribbling never looked so cool.
match_awards_soccertimewithballs_l_desc: Least travel time with the ball. Hopefully you were the goalie.
match_awards_soccerselfgoals_m_desc: Scored an Own Goal. At least the other team loves you.
match_awards_soccerrunesgathered_m_desc: Grabbed the most Runes. You really runed it for everyone else.
match_awards_soccerbeknockedouts_m_desc: Got Knocked Out the most. Everybody knows you're just faking.
match_awards_consumables_m_desc: Never get between a man and his potion! Used the most consumables.
match_awards_consumables_l_desc: There are more important things to buy! Used the least consumables.
match_awards_herokills_m_desc: Now you see me, now you're dead! Earned the most Hero Kills.
match_awards_herokills_l_desc: You're not worth my time. Had the least Hero Kills.
match_awards_level_m_desc: Get on my level! Was the highest level at the end of the match.
match_awards_deaths_l_desc: Fear death? Death fears me! Died the fewest times.
match_awards_heroassists_m_desc: Never fear, your savior is here! Earned the most Hero Assists.
match_awards_heroassists_l_desc: You'll be fine without me. Had the least Hero Assists.
match_awards_gold_m_desc: Give me the gold; I want the gold! Earned the most gold.
match_awards_gold_spent_m_desc: You can't take it with you. Spent the most gold.
match_awards_gold_spent_l_desc: But what if I need it later? Spent the least gold.
match_awards_herodmg_m_desc: That's going to leave a mark! Dealt the most damage to heroes.
match_awards_herodmg_l_desc: I'll go easy on you. Dealt the least damage to heroes.
match_awards_bdmg_m_desc: Dominating the countryside! Dealt the most damage to buildings.
match_awards_bdmg_l_desc: I respect your property, but that's about it. Dealt the least damage to buildings.
match_awards_razed_m_desc: Bet they wish they had insurance on that. Destroyed the most buildings.
match_awards_razed_l_desc: Preserve what few buildings are left in Newerth! Destroyed the least buildings.
match_awards_secs_dead_l_desc: Death? Ain't nobody got time for that! Spent the least amount of time dead.
match_awards_actions_m_desc: There's a direct correlation between APM and skill, right? Had the most actions per minute.
match_awards_actions_l_desc: When will they realize one click can get you to the same place? Had the least actions per minute.
match_awards_bloodlust_m_desc: I'm not embarrassed to say you were my first! Scored a Bloodlust.
match_awards_smackdown_m_desc: Why am I so much better than you? Scored the most Smackdowns.
match_awards_nemesis_m_desc: What are you going to do about it? Scored the most Nemeses.
match_awards_retribution_m_desc: Think you're tough? Think again! Scored the most Retributions.
match_awards_teamcreepkills_m_desc: Not to worry, I'll take care of this infestation. Killed the most creeps.
match_awards_teamcreepkills_l_desc: There are bigger fish to fry. Killed the least creeps.
match_awards_doublekill_m_desc: Never bet against me. Scored the most Double Taps.
match_awards_triplekill_m_desc: Pwning is as easy as 1, 2, 3. Scored the most Triple Kills.
match_awards_quadkill_m_desc: You can run, but you can't hide from me! Scored the most Quad Kills.
match_awards_annihilation_m_desc: NUFF SAID! Scored the most Annihilations.
match_awards_denies_m_desc: Better me than them! Scored the most creep denies.
match_awards_denies_l_desc: Best friends forever <3! Scored the least creep denies.
match_awards_neutcreepkills_m_desc: Welcome to the jungle! Killed the most neutral creeps.
match_awards_neutcreepkills_l_desc: Save the neutrals! Killed the least neutral creeps.
match_awards_wards_m_desc: I see you! Placed the most wards.
match_awards_humiliation_m_desc: You remember how you tried to Taunt me? Yeah, about that. Scored the most Humiliations.
match_awards_ks15_m_desc: Bow down, mortal! Scored the most 15x Streaks.
match_awards_ks10_m_desc: Is there no one who can face me? Scored the most 10x Streaks.
match_awards_ks5_m_desc: I just keep going and going and going. Scored the most 5x Streaks.
match_awards_ks3_m_desc: I'm going streaking! Scored the most 3x Streaks.
match_awards_avg_xpm_m_desc: Only the most elite live to tell the tale.
match_awards_special_2_desc: Fear the Chiprel and his friend.
match_awards_special_3_desc: All he needs is some love!
match_awards_special_4_desc: It's a tough job, but someone has to do it.
match_awards_special_5_desc: Revenant isn't the only one. We got this team!
match_awards_special_6_desc: Leave no stone unturned, no lane unexplored!
match_awards_special_7_desc: Don't you wish you were me?
match_awards_special_10_desc: Caught in the wrong place at the wrong time.
match_awards_special_11_desc: Good game, well played. Let's play another!
match_awards_special_12_desc: Whether it's a kill or a tower, I'll do whatever it takes!
match_awards_special_13_desc: The sun makes me sweat, let's take this fight somewhere cooler.
match_awards_special_14_desc: Newerth asked for a hero and I answered the call.
match_awards_special_15_desc: The lucky winner of the HoNor medallion!
match_awards_special_16_desc: Made magic happen. Figuratively or literally, you ask? I can't reveal my secrets.
match_awards_special_17_desc: Can't get enough of Mid Wars!
match_awards_special_18_desc: I called it first! Why is everyone else here?
match_awards_special_20_desc: If you have to ask, you'll never know.
game_hero_select_ready_tip: Click this button when you are ready to begin the game. After you are ready, you will not be able to swap or repick. When all players are ready, the match will start.
game_hero_select_ready_tip_no_hero: You must select a hero before you can ready yourself.
game_hero_select_ready_tip_other_ready: This player is ready for battle!
game_hero_select_ready_tip_not_ready: This player is not yet ready...
game_hero_select_random_tip_already_pick: You have already picked a hero.
game_hero_select_random_tip_free: Picking a random will not affect your starting gold.
game_hero_select_random_tip: Picking a random hero will give you ^y{gold}^* bonus gold.
hselect_swap_request_tip_text: Request to swap heroes with this player. After swapping you cannot repick or swap again.
hselect_swap_request_noeap_tip_text: You are unable to swap with this player as one of you does not have access to this EAP hero.
hselect_swap_accept_tip_text: This player has offered to swap heroes with you. Click on their portrait to complete the swap. After swapping you cannot repick or swap again.
game_hero_select_repick_tip_disabled: Repicking is disabled in this match.
game_hero_select_repick_tip_already_used: You have already used your repick.
game_hero_select_repick_tip_already_swap: You cannot repick because you have swapped.
game_hero_select_repick_tip_no_hero: After you pick a hero, you can use this button to undo your selection. Repicking costs ^y{gold}^* gold. You may only repick once. You cannot swap after repicking.
game_hero_select_repick_tip: Click this button to pick a new hero. Repicking costs ^y{gold}^* gold. You may only repick once. You cannot swap after repicking.
game_hero_select_repick_tip_free: Click here to pick a new hero. You may only repick once. You cannot swap after repicking.
game_hero_select_starting_gold_tip_me: You will have ^y{gold}^* gold at the start of the match.
game_hero_select_starting_gold_tip_other: This player will have ^y{gold}^* gold at the start of the match.
hero_select_voip_mute_tip: You have muted this player. Click here to un-mute them.
hero_select_voip_tip: Click here to mute this player.
main_lobby_replay_view_desc: Use the Match Stats viewer to review the match summary of past HoN games. With the Stats Viewer you can quickly find your recent games, look up games by match ID, and download replay files.
main_lobby_ranked_play_desc: Ranked Play allows you to create games with groups and even place different friends on opposing teams.  It will then take players looking for similar games based upon your preferences and attempt to create fair teams based upon statistics.  These matches are then used to rank players in our ladder.
main_lobby_button_quick_play_config_desc: Here you can select Bar, Neutral, or Preferred for all Game Modes and Game Options. Your client will then look through all the available games and join one based upon the preferences you select. The more options you bar, the longer it may take to join a game.
main_lobby_quick_play_desc: Use this to quickly and easily get into a Game Lobby based on your likes and dislikes. If you open the Quick Play Configuration just to the left you set all Modes and Options to help find a game you are looking for. Quick Play does NOT attempt to Matchmake based upon the skill of players looking for a game. Use iMatch for that feature.
mainlobby_label_qp_config_note: To configure Quick Play, you can set each of the categories below to preferred, neutral, or barred by clicking buttons below. When you click "Quick Play" you will be placed in a match that closest matches your configuration options.
main_lobby_qp_show_advanced_filters_labe: For advanced game filters, click the Show Advanced button to display all additional options.
main_lobby_qp_hide_advanced_filters_labe: To hide advanced game filters, click the Hide Advanced button to display all additional options.
mainlobby_label_join_size: Only Join Games With This Team Size
mainlobby_label_tier_tip: Restrict servers based on specified tier.  ^yNoobs Only^* - Only accounts with low overall account experience may play. ^yNoobs Allowed^* - Any player of any experience level may play. ^yPro^* - Only accounts that have achieved a high overall experience level may play.
mainlobby_label_min_max_psr_tip: Only allows players to join games if their specified PSR falls in within 2% of the servers Min/Max PSR range. A player who is invited to a game will bypass all Min/Max PSR restrictions.
main_lobby_leaver_restricted_desc: Restricted games are not available to players who have a history of leaving games before it is over.
mainlobby_button_custom_game_desc: If you don't want to use Quick Play and would like to manually look through the available games to join use this button. In the Game List you can filter the results for Team Size, Modes, Options, and Pings. If you want to quickly get in the action at the push of a button we suggest using Quick Play.
mainlobby_button_create_game_desc: Want to host a game that is set up exactly as you want it or make it easy for your friends to join? Use this feature! When creating a game you can set it to Private, wait for your friends to join, and then Announce it to fill the remaining spots.
main_lobby_game_name_desc: Filter the game browser by typing in a full or partial search phrase.  Use '|' to separate the search phrases, use '-' at the beginning of the phrase to exclude a term, and use '\\|' or '\\-' to escape the '|' or '-'.
mainlobby_label_custom_game_type_desc: Game Modes generally alter how hero selection works.  ^yAll Pick^* - Standard hero selection. ^yRandom Draft^* - Limits hero selection to 20 heroes then alternates picking between players. ^ySingle Draft^* - Each player is given a hero selection of one agility, one intelligence, and one strength hero. ^yBanning Draft^* - Identical to Random Draft, except Blue and Pink take turns banning 4 total heroes first. ^yBanning Pick^* - Blue and Pink take turns banning 8 total heroes, and then players alternate picking from the remaining hero pool.
mainlobby_label_custom_game_region_desc: Where the server is located geographically.
mainlobby_label_custom_team_size_desc: Restrict games to a particular team size.
mainlobby_label_custom_map_desc: Restrict games to a particular map.
mainlobby_label_custom_server_type_desc: Restrict games based on server type. Official servers are Frostburn hosted servers that are guaranteed to run official, non-modified game settings and maps. Unofficial servers are community hosted servers that may or may not be using modified maps and game settings.
main_lobby_view_advanced_filters: Click ^yView^* ^yAdvanced^* below to display all additional options.
mainlobby_button_custom_instant_upgrade: Instantly Upgrade to a Prime Account Now
mainlobby_tip_custom_game_access: Public matches are available to all players. Private matches require a password to join.
mainlobby_tip_filter_server_name: Enter a server name, or part of a server name to filter the results.
main_lobby_no_games_found: No games found! Why not create one?
main_lobby_avatar_tip_1: You can double-click to quickly select an avatar or right-click to close this screen.
mainlobby_gamelist_verifiedonly_desc: Only verified accounts can join this game.
mainlobby_gamelist_notverifiedonly_desc: Any account can join this game.
mainlobby_gamelist_official_desc: This is an official game, stats will be recorded.
mainlobby_gamelist_official_2_desc: This is an official game, stats will not be recorded.
mainlobby_gamelist_unofficial_desc: This is an unofficial game, stats will not be recorded.
mainlobby_gamelist_beginner_desc: Only new players can join this game.
mainlobby_gamelist_general_desc: All players can play in this game.
mainlobby_gamelist_veteran_desc: Only experienced players can join this game.
mainlobby_gamelist_noleaver_desc: Players with a high leave percentage can not join this game.
mainlobby_gamelist_caldavar_desc: Play a game on Forests of Caldavar
mainlobby_gamelist_darkwoodvale_desc: Play a game on the two lane map, Darkwood Vale
mainlobby_gamelist_grimmscrossing_desc: Play a game on Grimm's Crossing
mainlobby_gamelist_blitz_mode_desc: Play a Blitz Mode game on Grimm's Crossing
mainlobby_gamelist_midwars_desc: Play a game on Mid Wars
mainlobby_gamelist_midwars_old_desc: Play a game on Mid Wars Old
mainlobby_gamelist_riftwars_desc: Play a game on Rift Wars
mainlobby_gamelist_thegrimmhunt_desc: Play a game on The Grimm Hunt
mainlobby_gamelist_random_desc: Heroes are randomly distributed to all players. Team compositions are balanced.
mainlobby_gamelist_capturetheflag_desc: Play a game of capture the flag!
mainlobby_gamelist_devowars_desc: Play a game of Devo Wars!
mainlobby_gamelist_soccer_desc: Play a game of Strikers of Newerth!
mainlobby_gamelist_solo_desc: Play a game pure skilled One versus One!
mainlobby_gamelist_team_deathmatch_desc: Play a game of Team Deathmatch!
mainlobby_gamelist_reborn_desc: Each team votes for bans. Afterwards, teams share turns picking heroes; any player on the team can pick a hero.
mainlobby_gamelist_randomdraft_desc: Players take turns selecting heroes from a smaller random pool.
mainlobby_gamelist_singledraft_desc: Players choose one of three random heroes to play.
mainlobby_gamelist_banningdraft_desc: Players take turns selecting heroes from a smaller random pool after team captains remove several options from the pool.
mainlobby_gamelist_banningpick_desc: Team captains take turns banning three players per team, and then players alternate picking from the remaining hero pool.
mainlobby_gamelist_captainsdraft_desc: Captains first take turns banning heroes from a random pool and then take turns selecting a lineup for their teammates.
mainlobby_gamelist_krosmode_desc: Players pick a hero, and then heroes who's abilities will be added to a pool. Then, your abilities are randomly selected out of that pool each time you spawn.
mainlobby_gamelist_captainsmode_desc: Group leaders are the captains of the team and do all of the banning and picking for the team.
mainlobby_gamelist_deathmatch_desc: After dying, players are forced to select a new hero.
mainlobby_gamelist_balanced_random_desc: Heroes are randomly distributed to all players. Team compositions are balanced.
mainlobby_gamelist_blindban_desc: Players begin with the full pool of heroes. During the banning phase, each player gets to ban 1 hero without the other team knowing which heroes the other team chose to ban. Players are then shown the bans and are all given the ability to choose from the remaining heroes simultaneously.
mainlobby_gamelist_gated_desc: Players choose from a crafted pool of 40 heroes.
mainlobby_gamelist_private_desc: This game is only joinable if you have been invited.
mainlobby_gamelist_counterpick_desc: Players alternate picking from the hero pool in a 1-2-2-2-2-1 fashion. If the game contains all Legendary & Immortal ranked players, then a Blind Ban phase with 2 bans assigned to the Blue & Pink players will take place before picking starts.
mainlobby_gamelist_forcerandom_desc: Players are forced to take a random hero.
mainlobby_gamelist_forcepick_desc: Players are forced to play a specific hero.
mainlobby_gamelist_allrandom_desc: Players are forced to take a random hero.
mainlobby_gamelist_allheroes_desc: All heroes are available to both teams, regardless of faction.
mainlobby_gamelist_soccerpick_desc: Hero Selection is restricted to mode-specific heroes.
mainlobby_gamelist_easymode_desc: Game rules are modified to give all players more experience and gold, as well as decrease the power of base defenses.
mainlobby_gamelist_casual_desc: Game rules are modified to hasten progression and reduce punishment.  Recommended for beginning players and those seeking increased action.
mainlobby_gamelist_shuffleteams_desc: Players are randomly assigned to teams once the game starts.
mainlobby_gamelist_autobalance_desc: Once the game starts the teams will be auto balanced according to their PSR. After the hero select screen is loaded, players will be shown their teams for the first time. Locking slots is disabled when this game option is selected.
mainlobby_gamelist_more_desc: The host has enabled at least one of several advanced game options.
mainlobby_gamelist_devheroes_desc: Heroes currently unfinished and in development can be picked in this mode.
mainlobby_gamelist_hardcore_desc: There is no gold gain per second and creep/tower denies give 0 xp/gold to the opposing team.
mainlobby_gamelist_solosame_desc: Players select three heroes each.  Each player then bans two of the opponent's heroes.  You will then receive a random hero of the two remaining ones and both players go in-game with the same hero.
mainlobby_gamelist_solodiff_desc: Players select three heroes each.  Each player then bans two of the opponent's heroes.  You will then receive your remaining hero out of your pool of three.
mainlobby_gamelist_midwars_beta_desc: Modifies Mid Wars in a fun and exciting way!
mainlobby_gamelist_heroban_desc: Players begin with the full pool of heroes. Each player bans 2 heroes of their choice before the picking phase starts. No duplicate bans can be made.  After the banning phase ends, players can choose from the remaining heroes simultaneously.
mainlobby_gamelist_trial_blocked: Trial Accounts May Not Join Official Stats Recorded Games
mainlobby_gamelist_midwars_reborn_desc: Play a game on Mid Wars (PBT)!
replayv_label_replay_detail_info: To view replay details, select a replay file from the list at the left.
replay_view_tip_online: Browse the online database of replays.
replayv_tip_online_replays: You may download replays of matches by logging in and selecting "Play Online", and then clicking the "Match Stats" button.
replayv_tip_replay_list: Replays allow you to watch past matches, from the perspective of any player, or that of a spectator.
pofeatures_ppbenefit6: As a pre-purchased account you will no longer see this ad!
pofeatures_feature_matchmakingtxt: Get matched with similar players if you are playing yourself or with a team of friends.
pofeatures_feature_stattrackingtxt: Many statistics are tracked automatically by the game. Access an enormous amount of valuable data online or in-game.
pofeatures_feature_heroestxt: Play with heroes new to HoN as well as many of the best heroes your are already familiar with.
pofeatures_feature_laddertxt: Player and clan ladders are automatically updated by the game. See where you rank against the competition.
pofeatures_feature_questladdertxt: See how you stack up against other players in completing quests.
pofeatures_feature_editortxt: Create new maps, or even new games with the included map editor.
pofeatures_feature_reconnectiontxt: Games are no longer ruined when a player is disconnected - players that are disconnected can rejoin the game!
pofeatures_feature_noleavertxt: Create and play in restricted games that can not be joined by players with a history of leaving games early.
pofeatures_feature_netcodetxt: No lag for all players when one player has a connection issue!
pofeatures_feature_hotkeystxt: Bind custom hotkeys for almost every command in the game, allowing you to maximize your effectiveness.
pofeatures_feature_voiptxt: No need for an external voice chat program. Voice chat is incorporated into the HoN engine.
pofeatures_pptoday: To Pre-Purchase, Visit Our Website Today!
pofeatures_closemsg: To Pre-purchase your HoN account, log-in to the beta site and click the purchase button. Pre-purchasing your account is a one time fee, and your account will be ready to play as soon as the game is released.
game_replay_control_view_as_tip: When a player name is selected, you will view the replay as if you were that player. Selecting spectator will allow you to view the replay using the spectator interface.
game_replay_control_fog_tip: When selected, the Fog of War will be displayed as seen by the selected player.
game_replay_control_lockcam_tip: When selected, the camera will always follow the selected player.
game_replay_control_lockcam_tip2: Check this to follow the chosen player or shoutcaster's camera and mouse actions, when available.
game_replay_control_enablebullet_tip: When selected, bullet comments will be displayed.
globby_disabled_tip: Locking slots is disabled in this game mode.
globby_quick_stats: Wins Losses K:D A:D K+A:D Wards XPM GPM
game_gold_report: ^wGold Earned From Killing Players ^wGold Earned From Assisting Players Deaths ^wGold Earned From Buildings ^wGold Earned From Last Hitting Creeps ^wGold Lost To Dying ^vCurrent Buy Back Cost ^vCurrent Gold To Be Lost On Death ^wGold Per Min
gold_report_to_lose_on_death: Current Gold to Lose on Death
globby_purchase_txt2: Do you want to use it for this match only or purchase it?
globby_purchase_txt3: ^rWarning:^* Purchasing Early Access from this screen means you will be ineligible for the EA bonus bundles!
globby_purchase_eap_txt1: This is an Early Access Hero!
globby_purchase_eap_txt2: Early access grants you the ability to play this hero before it is released into the general hero pool.
globby_purchase_eap_nonleg_txt2: Early access grants you ownership and the ability to play this hero before it is released into the general hero pool.
gamelobby_referee_tip: Referees are appointed by the Game Host. They are most commonly used in competitive play to enforce the rules of the match.
gamelobby_private_tip_text: By selecting this feature, your game will not show up in the Game List. Players who have not been invited will not be able to join.
game_lobby_prediction_tip: Predicted chance for this team to win, based on Pub Skill Rating (PSR).
game_lobby_point_value_penalty_tip: This player's point values are reduced by ^922{percent}^* due to their high level.
game_lobby_point_value_tip: Number of rating points at stake for this player.
game_lobby_locklabel: You may lock players to their current slot by selecting them in the list below. If a player is locked, they will not be moved when Balance Teams is used.
game_lobby_lock_tip_label: Clicking on the colored icon next to a slot will lock the slot. Players will not be able to take this slot until it is unlocked. Locking a slot will also prevent Balance Teams from moving the player that occupies that slot.
game_lobby_host_locked_slot_tip: This slot is locked. Click here to unlock it. Players can not take a locked slot and Balance Teams will not move players from locked slots.
game_lobby_host_locks_disabled_tip: Locking slots is disabled when the game option "Auto Balanced" is selected.
game_lobby_host_open_slot_tip: This slot is unlocked. Click here to lock it. Players can not take a locked slot and Balance Teams will not move players from locked slots.
game_lobby_locked_slot_tip: The host has locked this slot. No player can take a locked slot and Balance Teams will not move players from locked slots.
game_lobby_random_bot_tip: Fill the current empty slots with random bots.
game_lobby_ack_timeout_body: Packet ack timeout, probably due to network unstable, you can either wait or try reconnecting.
game_lobby_ack_disconnect_body: Auto disconnected due to connection problem.
filter_solo_tip: Adept at solo lane, these heroes would prefer to go alone and largely benefit from quick experience.
filter_jungle_tip: Capable of clearing neutrals efficiently at early levels, these heroes prefer to avoid the laning phase.
filter_carry_tip: Generally weaker in the early phases, gold and items are more beneficial to these brawlers.
filter_support_tip: Anchors of team play. Supports are capable of contributing to a team effectively regardless of gold.
filter_pusher_tip: Pushers are powerful building wreckers. If uncontested, these heroes will make short work of the enemy base.
filter_initiator_tip: First in, last out. Initiators often provoke enemies and start fights by disrupting enemy coordination.
filter_ganker_tip: Efficient bounty hunters, these heroes excel at picking off isolated enemies.
filter_melee_tip: Limited in attack range, Melee heroes are typically very durable.
filter_ranged_tip: Ranged heroes are capable of attacking enemies from a safe distance.
filter_favorites_tip: Highlights your favorited heroes! Heroes can be favorited in the Learnatorium.
filter_reset_tip: Resets and clears the currently selected filters and search.
filters_tip_body: Filter heroes by categories. Heroes that match your selection will be highlighted.
game_menu_share_control_header: Unit Control Sharing Options and Player Voting
game_menu_share_control_text: You may share control of your units with your teammates. It can be useful to share control with teammates to allow them to use your pets.
game_menu_disband_confirm: Are you sure you want to disband?
game_menu_disconnect_confirm: Are you sure you want to disconnect?
game_menu_leave_percentage_text: Your Leave Percentage is the percentage of games that you have left before finishing.  Many players will create games that require a certain Leave Percentage.  By disconnecting too many games early (a high percentage), you may limit your ability to join those restricted games.
game_menu_quit_confirm: Are you sure you want to exit to desktop?
game_menu_kick_disabled_other_vote_toolt: You can not call a new vote until the current vote is over.
game_menu_kick_disabled_cooldown_tooltip: You need to wait {time} seconds before you can call another vote.
game_menu_remake_tooltip: Pressing this button will initiate a vote to remake the match. All players must vote unanimously in favor for the vote to pass. Remaking will put all players back in the lobby, as if the game had never started.
game_menu_concede_tooltip: Pressing this button will initiate a vote to concede the match. Your team must vote unanimously in favor for the vote to pass. Conceding counts as a loss, however once the match has been conceded everyone is free to leave without any penalty.
game_menu_endmatch_description: If the correct criteria is met, you may end the current game. A vote may be required to remake or concede.
game_menu_flow_description: You may pause at any time, but a team vote is required.
game_menu_pause_tooltip: Pressing this button will initiate a vote to pause the match. Your team must vote unanimously in favor for the vote to pass. Pausing will happen 5 seconds after the vote passes.
game_menu_unpause_tooltip: Pressing this button will unpause the game in 5 seconds. The team that paused the game may unpause anytime. The opposing team must wait 1 minute before unpausing.
game_menu_moved_title: Sharing, Remaking, Conceding, and Pausing Have Moved!
game_menu_moved: To share control, use the buttons on your team panel on the top left of the game screen. To Remake, Concede, or Pause, use the vote menu in the upper right of the game screen.
game_menu_nopauseleft_tooltip: Your team has used the maximum amount of pauses allowed for this match.
game_menu_sharing_tip: Toggles sharing your unit or your controlled units with allies.
game_menu_nohelp_tip: Toggles allowing allies to use potentially harmful abilities on your hero.
game_menu_voice_tip: Toggles voice chat and minimap pings from this ally on or off.
game_menu_voice_tip_spec: Toggles voice chat and minimap pings from this spectator on or off.
game_menu_report_a_player_tip: File a report of abusive behavior.

loading_tip1: Holding ^gCONTROL^* while using the shop will display recipe scrolls instead of the item, allowing you to quickly purchase the recipe.
loading_tip2: While using an ability, you can hold ^gSHIFT^* and select another ability to put it in your ability queue. As soon as the first ability has completed the next ability will fire immediately after.
loading_tip3: You can attack your own creeps when they are low health. If you kill them it results in a "deny" and surrounding enemies get much less experience than they would normally.
loading_tip4: If you attack your tower when it is low and destroy it, the enemy team gets much less gold than if they had destroyed it themselves.
loading_tip5: Typing /matchup or /ma in-game will print a list of all the players, heroes, levels, and player colors.
loading_tip6: You can sell an item from your stash by holding ^gSHIFT^* and ^gCONTROL^* when ^gRIGHT ^gCLICKING^* an item.
loading_tip7: You can quickly transfer an item between your stash and inventory by holding ^gCONTROL^* and ^gRIGHT ^gCLICKING^* the item.
loading_tip8: Lost track of where your hero is? Tapping the ^gC^* key will center the screen on your hero.
loading_tip9: Magic Armor reduces the damage you take from Magic damage, but doesn't provide any protection against physical attacks or abilities.
loading_tip10: Try to always have at least one Homecoming Stone. You never know when you'll need to help defend the other side of the map or use it to avoid being ganked.
loading_tip11: Holding ground (^gH^* by default) will stop your hero from attacking or moving, allowing you to time last hits with more precision.
loading_tip12: Typing /help will display a list of potentially useful commands available to you.
loading_tip13: Wards of Sight are an inexpensive way to gain a large advantage over opponents by watching where they go and who they are with.
loading_tip14: In the beginning of the game, never leave the base without a way to heal yourself.
loading_tip15: Kongor respawns 10 minutes after he is killed and reclaims the Token of Life if it has not been used after 5 minutes.
loading_tip16: Kongor drops the Token of Life when killed. The Token resurrects the holder instantly when they die, but is consumed in the process.
loading_tip18: A special powerup spawns every two minutes in the river and can grant you movement speed, invisibility, regeneration, double damage, or illusions.
loading_tip19: Neutral creeps respawn every minute as long as nothing is nearby.
loading_tip20: You can sell back an item for a full refund as long as it is within 15 seconds of when you bought it.
loading_tip21: The commands /ignorechat or /ic can be used to quickly ignore various forms of in-game chat.
loading_tip22: At the beginning of a match you can't take much damage so try to play defensive and stay behind your creeps, avoiding as much damage as possible.
loading_tip23: When the opposing team has heroes with invisibility, use Dust of Revelation, Wards of Revelation, or a Bound Eye to reveal them.
loading_tip24: Recipes are not useful on their own, you need all of the components before they will do anything for you.
loading_tip25: In the early game, if an enemy hero in your lane goes missing suddenly, be sure to let your team know. It can prevent them from being unexpectedly killed.
loading_tip26: Teamwork is essential to win. If you find yourself getting killed a lot while alone, stick with some allies.
loading_tip27: Watch the Minimap. It is a great tool for keeping an eye on your enemies position. Be careful for missing enemy heroes or allies coming to help you kill in your lane.
loading_tip28: Communication is important. Talk to your team, call for help, and listen to other players when they call a hero missing.
loading_tip29: To ping the minimap and alert your team, hold ^gALT^* and click an area!
loading_tip30: There is more than one way to play a hero. Try picking different items you might not normally use.
loading_tip31: Couriers cannot be used to fill up bottles from the fountain.
loading_tip32: Attacking enemy heroes when they are focusing on your teammate (and therefore ignoring you) can often turn a bad situation around. Use the opponents distraction to your advantage.
loading_tip33: There are lots of places you can enter the trees to hide or take shortcuts. Learning where these are will greatly increase your survival chances.
loading_tip34: When you read "Superior Magic" in a skill description, it means the skill will affect the target, even if it is magic immune.
loading_tip35: Look to see what skills are on cooldown from your team by highlighting their portraits top left.
loading_tip36: Your team will appreciate you more if you use high damage nukes early in fights rather than as finishers.
loading_tip37: You can see the gold, skills, health, and mana, of your allies at the top left of your screen. If you select their hero, you can see their items.
loading_tip38: Do not be afraid to lose. Good judgment comes from experience, and experience comes from bad judgment. Everyone was new at one point.
loading_tip39: Be nice! A player will often ignore advice if you are screaming at them. Try saying it in a polite tone as a suggestion more than an order.
loading_tip40: Typing /gameinfo or /gi in-game will print a list of the current game options.
loading_tip41: Clicking on this hint box will display a new hint.
loading_tip42: Selecting a ^!yRegion^* and enabling the "Filter Pre-Query" checkbox on game browser interface will allow you to browse and refresh games faster.
loading_tip43: When a notification pops up in-game, you can ^gRIGHT ^gCLICK^* anywhere on it to close it rather than clicking the 'X' button.
loading_tip44: You can turn specific notifications on or off, or disable notifications in-game by clicking "Options" and then navigating to the "Interface" tab.
loading_tip45: Each team can only pause up to 3 times per game. Use them wisely!
loading_tip46: You can use the command /friendlychat or /fc to only accept messages from players in your clan or on your friend list.
loading_tip47: A positive attitude is more likely to result in a positive outcome. Use constructive criticism to help your teammates improve!
loading_tip48: Lost an enemy hero in the trees? Dust of Revelation not only exposes invisible heroes, but can also be used to reveal the ones hidden in the Fog of War.
loading_tip49: Play as a team, respect each other.
loading_tip50: Buy a ward, save a life.
loading_tip51: Enable Detailed Ability Tooltips in interface options for deeper insight on hero abilities.
