rap_step3_title: What Type of Abuse Occurred in This Match?
rap_step4_grief_title: Specify The Type of Griefing That Occurred in This Match.
rap_step4_other_title: Specify The Type of Abuse Occurred in This Match.
rap_step5_title: Detail and Submit Your Abusive Behavior Report.
rap_final_time_cover: Specify the approximate abuse time using slider
rap_final_error_2: Please approximate the time of the incident.
rap_0_tiptxt: Feeding, avoiding AFK detection, ability and or item abuse. Item and/or courier spamming and destruction of items fall into this category.
rap_1_tiptxt: Excessive profanities, racial slurs, or spamming.
rap_1_longtxt: Excessive profanities, racial slurs, or chat spam only. Spamming chat involves flooding the screen of other players with text or ASCII art 5 lines or less. Flaming or mockery regardless of skill level does not fall into this category.
rap_2_tiptxt: Backdooring, leaving games, impersonating staff, and having a bad nickname.
rap_3_longtxt: Players who play poorly and repeatedly die do not fall under this category, only those who have the intent to feed the opposing team. In most cases you will need written proof that the player is intentionally feeding.
rap_4_tiptxt: Moving around to avoid being detected as AFK while not participating.
rap_4_longtxt: In this instance, the player will usually stay in the base, refusing to help, and only move when they are in danger of being marked AFK and getting kicked. If the player simply goes AFK and can be kicked, they are not avoiding AFK detection.
rap_5_tiptxt: Using items or spells to intentionally ruin the game.
rap_5_longtxt: Items or abilities such as Tablet of Command, Stormspirit, or Flux's "Magnetic Surge" that are constantly used on a teammate or yourself to ruin one's experience. Other instances can include a Behemoth constantly blocking players with Fissure, Succubus using Mesmerize on you, or a Blood Hunter using his silence ability on you.
rap_6_tiptxt: Sending countless couriers to their death or wasting countless wards.
rap_6_longtxt: Buying all the wards in the game and placing them in the base, or selling all items and buying couriers to feed to the enemy would be examples of this.
rap_7_tiptxt: Destroying one's items out of spite.
rap_7_longtxt: The destruction of a player's items with intent to upset others. Destroying items before disconnecting to spite your team is an example of this.
rap_8_tiptxt: Attacking a tower without any creeps by it.
rap_8_longtxt: Backdooring is not against the code of conduct and is not a reportable action. It is a viable strategy and can be easily countered with a homecoming stone.
rap_9_tiptxt: Leaving in the middle of games, also known as "Rage Quitting".
rap_9_longtxt: Simply leaving the game and not breaking any other rules does not warrant a suspension. The player already gains leave percentage. If he has broken a rule, please report him for that instead.
rap_10_tiptxt: Not warding, dying a lot, and using skills ineffectively.
rap_10_longtxt: Being unskilled or bad is not a reportable offense. Try to teach them how to play better instead.
rap_11_tiptxt: Not being an asset in team fights, such as not using their skill when they could have.
rap_11_longtxt: Only report the player if he is intentionally avoiding team fights in order to force a loss.
rap_12_tiptxt: Impersonation of Frostburn or any volunteer position, including Moderators and Game Masters.
rap_12_longtxt: In this case, if a player claims to be a staff member or a Game Master and says he is going to suspend you, this would be a reportable offense.
rap_14_tiptxt: Any offense that does not fit into one of the other categories.
rap_14_longtxt: You are about to submit a custom report. Please be sure to provide a detailed description of the abuse you believe to have occurred. This can include Stats Manipulation and Bug Exploitation.
rap_non_goback_tip: None of these abuses occurred, go back to the previous screen.
rap_warning: When reporting abusive player behavior, make sure to provide information as accurately as possible.  Abuse of the report system will result in your account not being able to use this system.
rap_sub_error_8: You do not have required deposit funds (users are required to pay a deposit on tickets, which are refunded when a suspension is successful)
rap_sub_error_9: You may not submit RAP tickets due to infractions from previous bad reports.
rap_sub_error_11: You may not report players for actions in a No-Stats match
rap_sub_error_12: Player already reported for this match
rap_deposit_desc: These coins will be used as a deposit for your RAP submission. If the player is found guilty or it has been 7 days without a decision, you will receive your coins back. If the player was innocent, you will not receive your coins back.
rap_non_offence: I'm sorry but this is not a reportable offense. If you have any further questions, please visit the Report-A-Player discussion forum. Click this message to close.
rap_cooldown_period_tip: All reports have a 2 minute cooldown after the match is completed before it can be reported - the cooldown may vary up to ~5 minutes due to how match submissions and match duration calculations function. Please take this time to reflect on the match and assure that the actions of the player are reportable.
rap_cooldown_explanation: All reports have a 2 minute cooldown after the match is completed before it can be reported - the cooldown may vary up to ~5 minutes due to how match submissions and match duration calculations function. Please take this time to reflect on the match and assure that the actions of the player are reportable.
rap_nonevent_example: The following is an example of an invalid report:
rap_3_nonevent_title: You have opted to file a report for Intentional Feeding
rap_3_nonevent_deposit: Please note that the following are examples of ^ynon-reportable instances^* of Intentional Feeding. If you report any of these actions, your case will be closed and your ^ydeposit will be lost^*.
rap_3_nonevent_li_1: Player was playing poorly due to a lack of skill
rap_3_nonevent_li_3: Player claims he is going to feed but never does
rap_3_nonevent_li_4: Player is under leveled and dies easily
rap_3_nonevent_detail: If a player is intentionally feeding it will be apparent in their behavior, usually by running down the lane to the enemies to die, over and over again. Players will often announce they are going to feed, however this isn't always the case. If a player begins to feed they will usually do it multiple times to ensure defeat.
rap_3_nonevent_example: Player "1337honn3r" reports: "Offender went 2/6 mid and made us lose the game." This report was marked innocent because the offender did not intentionally feed. Although they may have failed during the lane-phase the offender was simply playing poorly.
rap_4_nonevent_title: You have opted to file a report for AFK Detection Abuse
rap_4_nonevent_deposit: Please note that the following are examples of ^ynon-reportable instances^* of AFK Detection Abuse. If you report any of these actions, your case will be closed and your ^ydeposit will be lost^*.
rap_4_nonevent_li_1: Player was kicked though and AFK vote
rap_4_nonevent_li_2: Player was marked AFK and was never kicked
rap_4_nonevent_li_3: Player went legitimately AFK, and game ended before player could be kicked
rap_4_nonevent_detail: AFK Detection is designed to allow allied players to remove an offender who has decided to quit playing the game. When kicked, this provides the remaining team members with a gold bonus and items, allowing them to better continue their game.
rap_4_nonevent_example: Player "1337honn3r" reports: "Offender went to the pool at level 4 and stayed there until the end of the game." This report was marked innocent because the offender sat in the well and did not move or cast spells. An AFK flag was raised, but he was never kicked.
rap_5_nonevent_title: You have opted to file a report for Ability/Item Abuse
rap_5_nonevent_deposit: Please note that the following are examples of ^ynon-reportable instances^* of Ability/Item Abuse. If you report any of these actions, your case will be closed and your ^ydeposit will be lost^*.
rap_5_nonevent_li_1: Player uses spells and abilities in attempt to save you from death
rap_5_nonevent_li_2: Player accidentally misses/targets an ability that affects you
rap_5_nonevent_li_3: Player chooses not to heal or use spells that may benefit you
rap_5_nonevent_detail: Ability and/or Item Abuse occurs when players attempt to disrupt teammates by using specific items or abilities. "No-Help" can be toggled by clicking the green circle next to their hero portrait, but is still a reportable offense if used to effect the outcome of the game.
rap_5_nonevent_example: Player "1337honn3r" reports: "While trying to escape, my ally used a tablet of command on me, and I accidentally got stuck in trees." This report was deemed innocent because the reported player was attempting to use his item for its intended purpose.
rap_6_nonevent_title: You have opted to file a report for Item/Courier Spamming
rap_6_nonevent_deposit: Please note that the following are examples of ^ynon-reportable instances^* of Item/Courier Spamming. If you report any of these actions, your case will be closed and your ^ydeposit will be lost^*.
rap_6_nonevent_li_1: Player allows the courier to be killed on accident and will not buy a new one.
rap_6_nonevent_li_2: Player buys all the wards, but places them appropriately
rap_6_nonevent_li_3: Player purchases items that may not be beneficial, but can't be lost when dropped
rap_6_nonevent_detail: If a player is mass purchasing items and/or couriers, they often hinder the team. Such examples of this include, but are not limited to: purchasing all the wards and placing them in base, buying a Bound Eye then sacrificing it to the other team, or buying multiple couriers and sending them to die.
rap_6_nonevent_example: Player "1337honn3r" reports: "Our ally bought wards but placed it so it couldn't see the rune spawn." This report was deemed innocent because the wards were placed to give vision of enemy heroes, despite the lack of knowledge the player had of warding spots.
rap_7_nonevent_title: You have opted to file a report for Item Destruction
rap_7_nonevent_deposit: Please note that the following are examples of ^ynon-reportable instances^* of Item Destruction. If you report any of these actions, your case will be closed and your ^ydeposit will be lost^*.
rap_7_nonevent_li_1: Courier dies while delivering items to a player
rap_7_nonevent_li_2: Player destroys items that cannot be sold, such as a Logger's Hatchet
rap_7_nonevent_li_3: Enemies destroying allied items that have been placed on the ground or falling from a courier
rap_7_nonevent_li_4: Destroying runes despite players being nearby
rap_7_nonevent_detail: Item Destruction can be reported when a player (and more often an ally) destroys items that could benefit you or the team. A common example is a player that destroys their own items before disconnecting, in order to leave the allied teammembers without any sort of compensation.
rap_7_nonevent_example: Player "1337honn3r" reports: "I was at the secret shop buying a Ward, but had to drop my Codex on the ground to do that. This enemy Night Hound attacked and destroyed my Codex." This report was deemed innocent because the reporter is at fault for dropping their item out in the open. If conditions are unsafe, it may be best to wait until you are back at base.
rap_1_nonevent_title: You have opted to file a report for Chat Abuse
rap_1_nonevent_deposit: Please note that the following are examples of ^ynon-reportable instances^* of Chat Abuse. If you report any of these actions, your case will be closed and your ^ydeposit will be lost^*.
rap_1_nonevent_li_1: You and the offender both insult each other
rap_1_nonevent_li_2: Player uses a few insults about you playing poorly
rap_1_nonevent_detail: If a player is verbally abusing you or teammates, do not respond to their insults. Players that fall into this category will often sling degrading and racially derogatory terms in hopes of hurting the other players on an emotional level. Furthermore ASCII characters 5 lines or under are not considered Chat Abuse.
rap_1_nonevent_example: Player "1337honn3r" reports: "Offender told me "Your momma so fat when Devourer hooks her he gets pulled in" and he called me an idiot." This report was marked innocent because the offender did not verbally harass the player to the point of wanting to emotionally harm him.

referral_longtxt: Referring friends to Heroes of Newerth is a quick and easy way to bring more players to HoN, and earn Goblin Coins for your efforts! As you mentor your referred friends, you will receive rewards as they progress:
referral_url_txt: Pass along this personal referral link on to your friends. When they create an account, it will be marked as a referral on your account.

mentor_promo_txt1: You've asked for it and we've delivered! Mentoring is here to give players the ability to teach HoN to their friends. New players will be able to learn HoN faster than ever. With the help of their friends, they'll be playing on the same level in no time.
mentor_promo_li1: View your pupil's screen live, in real time
mentor_promo_li2: Communicate using the private mentoring chat channel, supporting both voice and text
mentor_promo_li3: Give pointers by displaying your cursor and pinging directly onto your pupil's screen
mentor_promo_txt2: Start mentoring your friends now by right clicking a friend's name in your Friend List or Chat List and choosing 'Mentor Friend'.
mentor_promo_txt3: Included in Mentoring is the ability to Spectate your friend's matches live. Gone are the days of waiting for your friends to finish their games or leaving them behind to start your own. Jump into your friend's game and spectate all the excitement in real time from the same perspective you'd get as a mentor.

mentor_promo_prof_txt: Mentor and play with your referred friends and when their account reaches level three, both of you will receive the Professor Repulsor Alt Avatar, exclusively available through this promotion.

main_walkthrough_1_10: Congratulations! You have purchased your very first item. Feel free to browse the other goodies on offer here in the HoN Store, or start playing now to earn coins and unlock more items!
main_walkthrough_2_1: Enter the HoN Store now to redeem your free coins!
main_walkthrough_2_2: This is the Specials page, where new and featured items are displayed. Click 'Avatars' to continue on toward claiming your item!
main_walkthrough_2_7: You've found your item!  Click to preview its model and abilities!
main_walkthrough_2_8: Click Purchase to permanently add this item to your collection!
main_walkthrough_2_9: For standard purchases, you can use Gold Coins, which are purchased, or Silver Coins, which are earned through playing Matchmaking games.
main_walkthrough_2_10: Congratulations! You have purchased your very first Hero of Newerth Upgrade. Feel free to browse the other goodies on offer here in the HoN Store, or start playing now to earn coins and unlock even more!
walkthrough_lobby_pick_pyromancer_body: For this match, you will start with Pyromancer.  Click the highlighted Pyromancer icon to select him as your hero.
walkthrough_pregame_quest1_title: Right click to move to the waypoint
walkthrough_pregame_quest1_description: Right click on the waypoint to move your hero to its location. Press C to center the camera on your hero.
walkthrough_pregame_quest2_description: You start off with one skill point, choose an ability and level it up!
walkthrough_pregame_quest3_title: Right click to purchase a starting item from the shop
walkthrough_pregame_quest3_description: Before you get into battle, it is important to purchase starting items at the shop!
walkthrough_pregame_quest4_title: Defend your base tower from the enemy attack!
walkthrough_pregame_quest4_description: The Hellbourne Creeps are attacking your base! Help defend your base tower! Right Click enemies to attack them.
walkthrough_pregame_sidequest1_title: Use an ability to kill enemies
walkthrough_pregame_quest5_description: You've defended your base from the enemy invasion!
walkthrough_game_quest1_description: Follow the Legion soldiers, otherwise known as creeps, into a lane where they will engage the enemy.
walkthrough_game_quest2_description: Your first goal is to destroy an enemy outer tower
walkthrough_game_sidequest1_title: Get the last hit on 3 enemy creeps
walkthrough_game_sidequest1_description: Last hitting creeps is the primary way to get gold in the early levels and throughout the game, focus on getting the last hit on enemy creeps.
walkthrough_game_sidequest2_title: Purchase an upgraded Marchers from the shop
walkthrough_game_sidequest2_description: Purchase an upgraded Marchers from the shop to allow your hero to move faster!
walkthrough_game_quest3_description: Good job! You've destroyed an outer tower, now destroy an enemy inner tower!
walkthrough_game_quest4_description: Good job! You've destroyed an inner tower, now destroy an enemy base tower!
walkthrough_game_quest5_description: Good job! You've destroyed a base tower, the enemy barracks are now vulnerable in this lane!
walkthrough_game_quest6_description: Great Work! Now that the enemy barracks have been destroyed, your creeps in this lane will spawn  stronger than they were before!  Move onward to the Shrine Towers!
walkthrough_game_quest7_description: Now that the Shrine towers have been destroyed, the enemy Base Structure is now vulnerable!  Destroy it to end the game!
walkthrough_tip1_text: It is important to stay behind your allied creeps to avoid taking unnecessary damage.
walkthrough_tip2_text: You are low on health, use a restoration item or go back to the fountain to heal to avoid dying.
walkthrough_tip3_text: Be careful around towers, they deal a large amount of damage and will defend assailed enemy heroes.
walkthrough_tip4_text: You've died! You will respawn at your fountain after a short duration, in Normal Mode you lose gold from death.
walkthrough_tip5_text: Stay away from the enemy's fountain to avoid taking a large amount of damage.
walkthrough_tip6_text: This is the observatory where you may purchase regeneration consumables or wards to give your team vision of the map.
walkthrough_tip7_text: This is the side shop where you may purchase a variety of items without returning to the base.
walkthrough_tip8_text: In order to get back to the lane faster, you may purchase a homecoming stone and use it to teleport to an allied structure.
walkthrough_tip9_text: You've reached level 6 and unlocked your Ultimate ability!  Ultimate abilities are typically much stronger than regular abilities.
walkthrough_tip10_text: You've gotten a Rune!  Runes spawn periodically in the river and grant you powerful effects when picked up.
walkthrough_tip11_text: This is a neutral camp. Neutrals are found in the jungles of both sides of the map and may be killed for gold and experience.
walkthrough_tip12_text: You've killed an enemy hero! Killing heroes grants you a large amount of gold and experience, and sets the enemy's progress back greatly.
walkthrough_tip13_text: Kongor is the king of the jungle.  Killing him typically requires a team effort and grants your team a large reward!
walkthrough_tip20_text: Welcome to The Forests of Caldavar, where the Legion and the Hellbourne fight for control of Newerth!
walkthrough_tip21_text: The objective of Heroes of Newerth is to destroy the enemy's base structure, the Sacrificial Shrine, or the Tree of Life
walkthrough_tip22_text: In order to achieve victory, your team must battle through the enemy heroes and defenses.
walkthrough_tip23_text: The best way to accomplish this is to build up the power of your hero, both through gaining experience to level up and gold to purchase powerful items.
walkthrough_tip24_text: Each game starts at the fountain in your base where you can always go to heal yourself and purchase items.
walkthrough_tip25_text: Good Work! You used an ability to destroy your enemies!
walkthrough_tip26_text: In the Forests of Caldavar, your team consists of five players who begin the game by spreading themselves out between the three lanes of the map where they will battle the enemy and gain experience.
walkthrough_tip27_text: You leveled up! Use one of your first two abilities by clicking it and clicking the ground to deal area of effect damage to the enemies.
walkthrough_tip28_text: You may purchase recommended items from the hero guide or choose your own from the item list.
lobby_walkthrough_text1: This is the hero pick screen where you will select your hero before you get into a game. For this match, you will start with Pyromancer.  Click Pyromancer.
lobby_walkthrough_text2: Now click the ready button to start the game.

chat_walkthrough_info_2: Left click the tabs above the chat window to quickly change chat filters.

rewardstat_feedback_q1: How much did you like playing Genesis (the new hero)?
rewardstat_feedback_q2: Briefly explain what you liked/disliked about Genesis.
rewardstat_feedback_q3: How much fun did you have with the Nitro rework?
rewardstat_feedback_q4: Did you like Pestilence getting a 450/700/950/1200 range leap on the 2nd activation of Flight?
maliken_says2: Happy 5th HoNiversary!  Thank you for being a significant part of this huge achievement!
maliken_says3: It's difficult to believe that it has already been 5 years since HoN was first released.  We have seen a ton of changes and genre-defining features since then, and today is no exception!
maliken_says4: Headlining today's patch is the incredibly fun, community-created Capture the Flag map (a huge shout out to HyperXewl and Kawaiiiii!).  Here at the studio, we have been addicted to this map for months and we are very excited to be able to play it with all of you now!  You'll also find one of our most impactful balance patches ever introduced and have your first chance to play as the world-shattering Parallax, among many other additions we have incorporated into HoN.  We're excited to hear your feedback on the biggest HoNiversary patch to date, so stop by the forums and let us know what you think!
maliken_says5: Not only is this a big day for HoN, it is also a big day for the entire HoN team.  We are thrilled to announce that HoN and the team responsible for its success have split from S2 Games and have been acquired by Garena, our long-time partner and leading game publisher in Asia, who is responsible for HoN's massive success in Southeast Asia.  They have since entrusted us with HoN's operations as we strive to enhance the game quality and your in-game experience. To pay homage to our roots, we have named ourselves Frostburn Studios and have made it our mission to deliver you the most captivating and unforgettable gaming experiences.
maliken_says6: For more information on the HoN acquisition, the HoNiversary, or to chat with us, head on over to the forums and check out my post in General Discussion.
maliken_says7: We cannot thank you enough for your continued support!  We hope you will enjoy the latest patch and everything that Frostburn Studios has lined up for you in the days ahead.
maliken_says8: I look forward to connecting with you soon!

hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_accursed_1: During Flame Consumption, place yourself in harm's way to heal more. Cauterize will also heal you.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_accursed_2: Use Fire Shield to remove debuffs and stuns from allies.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_accursed_1: Avoid damaging Accursed when he uses Flame Consumption.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_accursed_2: Back away from targets with Fire Shield before damaging them if possible.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_adrenaline_1: Rush is a great initiation and retreat tool, saving enough mana to use this if needed is never a bad idea.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_adrenaline_2: Items such as Power Supply and Blood Chalice may be activated to grant Adrenaline an extra ability use in a time of need.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_adrenaline_1: When you have many Stacks of Dread built up on you, letting the debuff fall off before re-engaging could save you from a quick death.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_adrenaline_2: Stormspirit is a powerful tool to stop Adrenaline's ultimate combo from killing yourself or an ally.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_aluna_1: Pressing Deja Vu once gives Aluna a speed burst which can help to get away. Pressing it again can confuse enemies as to where you really are. The third time teleports you back to your image and disjoints any incoming projectiles.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_aluna_2: Remember that you can stop Power Throw mid cast if it looks like you won't hit it.  Order Stop is bound to "s" by default.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_aluna_1: Move erratically if you are expecting a charged Power Throw.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_aluna_2: Avoid standing next to the last creep in your wave to prevent Emerald Lighting from stunning you.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_apex_1: The Burning Ember can keep you in your lane or allow you to return to a fight without having to return to the fountain, be sure to make good use of it.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_apex_2: Fire Surge is an excellent harass and poke tool. Using this ability in conjunction with a Blood Chalice, can provide a constant stream of damage.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_apex_1: Magic Immunity is key in facing Apex. Make sure to get a shrunken head as soon as possible.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_apex_2: Apex has a low mana pool and a lot of spells to cast. Try a nullfire or heroes that have mana draining, burning abilities.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_ra_1: Path of Destruction allows you to move through terrain; use this to your advantage.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_ra_2: Consider not casting spells when you are already low on hit points.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_ra_1: Path of Destruction has a set range of 600. Move perpendicularly to avoid it.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_ra_2: Draining Amun-Ra's mana can reduce the effect of Pyroclasmic Rebirth after he dies.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_andromeda_1: Use Void Rip to swap positions with an unknowing enemy. Stun him to ensure an escape.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_andromeda_2: Aurora can be used to scout areas covered by fog of war.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_andromeda_1: Avoid Andromeda's Void Rip by staying behind allies or buying a Nullstone.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_andromeda_2: Andromeda is one of the most effective support gankers.  Be aware of where she is on the map.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_arachna_1: Try to activate Harden Carapace before you start taking damage. Support heroes and casters make easy prey for your Spider Sting.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_arachna_2: Harden Carapace can be saved to clear a specific debuffs such as Keeper of the Forest's Root.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_arachna_1: Aracha has no interrupting ability. Carry a Homecoming Stone and teleport out if you are in trouble.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_arachna_2: The Spider Sting's Spiderling can be killed if attacked four times.  It can be killed easily with help from a teammate.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_armadon_1: Try to anticipate enemy attacks and turn Armadon's back to them. By doing this Armordillo will cause more Spine Bursts to fire off and decrease incoming damage!
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_armadon_2: Try to save mana to use in a sustained battle where you can get multiple Spine Bursts off in a row on enemies.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_armadon_1: Keep track of Spine Burst stacks and back off if they are getting too high. Armadon deals the most damage in sustained battles.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_armadon_2: Armadon has no interrupting ability. Carry a Homecoming Stone and teleport out if you are in trouble.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_bephelgor_1: Running over corpses replenishes Balphagore's health. Although this is not much, it can often make the difference in a fight.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_bephelgor_2: Regurgitate can be used simply to heal and get charges for Corpse Conversion.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_bephelgor_1: Don't forget that Balphagore's minions do a lot of damage over time while putting a stacking slow on someone each time they hit.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_bephelgor_2: Items such as Shieldbreaker and Hellflower are great ways to help kill enemy tank heroes like Balphagore.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_behemoth_1: Try to use Fissure to stun and block off paths from assailants.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_behemoth_2: A clumped group of enemies makes easy prey for Shockwave. Buy a Portal Key to help you position yourself optimally.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_behemoth_1: When Shockwave is available, it is imperative to keep your team scattered. A clumped team will die almost instantly against a Behemoth.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_behemoth_2: Be aware of Behemoth's positioning and where he can Fissure to block you.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_blacksmith_1: Frenzy can be used for a movespeed buff to help get away from enemies. Using Fireball and Flaming Hammer can also slow enemies down.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_blacksmith_2: Time your Fireball to cast immediately after Flaming Hammer hits your target to maximize magic damage.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_blacksmith_1: Flaming Hammer lowers your magic armor, picking up some extra magic armor from Mystic Vestments or going for Shrunken Head can help prevent this.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_blacksmith_2: Nullstone is an effective counter to heroes with powerful single target spells such as Blacksmith.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_hunter_1: If being pursued, cast Hemorrhage to force them to take damage. If they lose too much health, you will gain movement speed from Blood Sense.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_hunter_2: Blood Crazy is one of the best silences in the game, but be careful about casting it on enemy heroes with high attack damage.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_hunter_1: Don't move while afflicted with Hemorrhage! Blood Hunter lacks an interrupt, so carry a Homecoming Stone and teleport out if necessary.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_hunter_2: Be careful not to get too low on hit points while killing neutral creeps against a team with Blood Hunter.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_bombardier_1: Use Bombardment to slow assailants. Sticky Bomb can also be used as a deterrent.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_bombardier_2: Heroes stop moving when they attack.  Use this period as an opportunity to drop a Sticky Bomb on them.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_bombardier_1: Stay away from allies and get in a safe position if you have Sticky Bomb on you.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_bombardier_2: Air Strike has global range, so be attentive and pick unusual paths to retreat when you're low on hit points.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_bubbles_1: Cast Shell Surf then Take Cover to become invulnerable before teleporting away.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_bubbles_2: A clumped group of enemies makes easy prey for Song of the Sea and Kelp Field. A Portal Key can help catch enemies clumped or help you escape after a Take Cover.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_bubbles_1: Pay attention to where Bubbles is Shell Surfing. Not doing so often leads to him porting to it afterwards to hit players with Song of the Sea and Kelp Field.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_bubbles_2: It's important to stay scattered to avoid Song of the Sea and Kelp Field when you anticipate a team fight against Bubbles.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_calamity_sun: Use your W and E keys to move your orbs in and out, allowing you to deal damage to enemies that are far away without putting yourself at risk!
Remeber that Funeral Pyre's wall is not instantly set up. It takes time to create the circle, so plan ahead!
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_calamity_sun: Move away from the bouncing Rain of Fire, as you will get pulled back into it every time you are hit again!
If you are caught inside of the Funeral Pyre's wall, turn and fight! You can't run through it!
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_chi_1: A Thousand Cuts is a great zoning tool that procs Enlightenment and clears creep waves. Be sure to use this often and have high Mana sustain!
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_chi_2: Late-game, save your Disarm on Crippling Puncture for enemy autoattack carries. It will ruin their day!
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_chi_1: A Thousand Cuts is relatively slow-moving and has high mana upkeep for Qi. Dodge this as best you can, and don't let Qi get the upper hand in the early game!
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_chi_2: Ancestral Assault has a small delay before it triggers. Be alert to dodge the heavy burst damage from it!
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_chipper_1: Quickly cast Rocket Barrage on assailants to mini-stun and slow them down. If they come too close, Tar Toss to slow them further.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_chipper_2: If you're having trouble hitting Rocket Barrage, try saving it for when the enemy is closer, mid attack animation, or is immobilized.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_chipper_1: Stay out of Sawblade Showdown! If hit by Tar Toss, try to move erratically to dodge an incoming Rocket Barrage.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_chipper_2: Chipper does large amounts of magic damage, picking up some extra magic armor from Mystic Vestments or going for Shrunken Head can help prevent this.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_chronos_1: Time Leap should either be used as initiation, leading into Chronofield, or saved as an escape.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_chronos_2: Position Chronofield so that you catch enemies on the close edge in order to allow friendly melee units to help attack them.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_chronos_1: Kill Chronos early and often to prevent him from farming. A late game Chronos should be focused relentlessly.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_chronos_2: It's important to stay scattered to avoid Chronofield when you anticipate a team fight against Chronos.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_corrupteddis: Cast Corrupted Conduit on an assailant to drain his damage. Use your superior movement speed to escape, or simply turn on him for a kill once you've drained his damage.
Corrupted Disciple does well in sustained battles where he can stack up Corrupted Conduit and keep Overload hitting enemies. Protective items can help battles become prolonged.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_corrupteddis: Corrupted Conduit lowers your damage while increasing Corrupted Disciple's and giving him vision of the target! Avoid this by running 700 or more units away from Corrupted.
Keep track of how long Corrupted Disciple has had Corrupted Conduit on.  Corrupted Disciple can do devastating damage if he has a high stack of Corrupted Conduit.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_cthulhuphant: The damage reduction from Hook'em only applies if enemies hit Cthulhuphant in the front. Trample can also be used as a way to escape from enemies.
Trample through creeps to help ensure a stun and deal extra damage.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_cthulhuphant: Trample pushes creeps in front of Cthulhuphant dealing extra damage and stunning; avoiding creeps between Cthulhuphant and you can often allow you to dodge the trample completely.
Deal damage from behind to avoid Cthulhuphant's Hook'em shield.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_dampeer_1: Vampiric Flight and Consume can be used to regain hit points quickly. Fighting is sometimes the solution to surviving!
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_dampeer_2: Queue up spells while using Vampiric Flight. Queuing can be done by holding "Shift" by default.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_dampeer_1: Buy Magic Armor to mitigate Dampeer's spell damage.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_dampeer_2: Ganking Dampeer will shut down his ganking potential for a couple of minutes while he has to regain Essences to be effective.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_vanya_1: Cast Cover of Darkness to blind enemies, then use Charging Strikes to escape.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_vanya_2: Taint Soul can be used as an effective last hitting tool when getting in melee range isn't an option.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_vanya_1: Avoid Dark Lady when she has Dark Blades activated. She is much more vulnerable without them!
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_vanya_2: Kill Dark Lady early and often to prevent her from farming. A late game Dark Lady should be focused relentlessly.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_deadwood_1: Activate Clearcutting and head straight for the trees when in trouble. Your opponents will lose sight of you.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_deadwood_2: Rotten Grasp can make Willowmaker do extra damage by reducing enemy armor.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_deadwood_1: Buy copious amounts of armor to prevent Willowmaker from blasting you away.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_deadwood_2: Vision from Wards of Sight and good movement speed can be the best way to avoid a Rotten Grasp and Willowmaker combo completely.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_defiler_1: Activate Unholy Expulsion and attack a single target to quickly bring him down. Buy protective items, as your primary source of damage output comes from using Unholy Expulsion and keeping yourself alive!
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_defiler_2: Wave of Death has a short cooldown and can be cast at considerable range affecting multiple enemies at once. Position and mobility are key for lining up your enemies.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_defiler_1: Never take on Defiler one-on-one when she has Unholy Expulsion activated. Be mindful of your health when fighting her; when the ghosts start swooping in, you're going to be in trouble.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_defiler_2: Wave of Death has a very long range. Move perpendicularly to avoid it.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_shaman_1: Cast Unbreakable on yourself when you're at low health. Any instance of lethal damage will heal you instead!
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_shaman_2: Try to kite enemy heroes into your friendly creep wave and then cast Healing Wave for a devastating effect.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_shaman_1: Lethal damage will heal Demented Shaman when he has Unbreakable activated. A small amount of armor will go a long way to mitigating the effects of Storm Cloud!
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_shaman_2: Avoid standing in the enemy creep wave to prevent taking up to 700 physical damage from a Healing Wave.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_devourer_1: Intermittently turn Decay on and off to slow and damage assailants. If they lack an interrupt, Devour one of them to cause a large health swing before continuing to escape or turning on them for a kill.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_devourer_2: Buying magic armor such as Mystic Vestments or Shaman's Headdress will help you take less damage from your own Decay.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_devourer_1: Interrupt Devourer as soon as he begins to Devour.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_devourer_2: Move erratically and stay behind allied creeps to avoid being grabbed by Guttling Hook.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_doctorrepuls: You can use abilities and items while moving with Ludicrous Speed.
Keep a high mana pool to ensure you can get into and out of a fight with Ludicrous Speed when needed.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_doctorrepuls: Make good use of crowd control when fighting Dr. Repulsor. He doesn't have much burst damage, but his sustained damage and mobility can get out of control if you don't kill him early.
Hellflower and other silencing effects are very effective at shutting down Doctor Repulsor.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_drunkenmaste: Drink passively boosts your other abilities as long as charges are in reserve. Activating Drink will drain your reserve charges and replenish some life.
Use Stagger to disjoint incoming spells and attacks when in trouble.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_drunkenmaste: Avoid casting targeted spells on Drunken Master while Untouchable is activated.
Drunken Master deals a lot of physical damage, so buying armor will help to mitigate his usefulness.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_deadlift_1: Try using Onslaught on towers and structures when enemy creep waves are nearby to quickly damage them.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_deadlift_2: You can control the direction and extend the range of Death Grip by reactivating the ability while channelling.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_deadlift_1: Make sure to take out enemy gravestones to stop Deadlift from reviving them.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_deadlift_2: Be careful when next to a large creep wave, Onslaught causes all nearby units to instantly aggro a target outputting high physical damage rapidly.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_electrician_: When escaping, activate Electric Shield as often as possible to mitigate incoming damage. Use Cleansing Shock on yourself to boost your own speed.
Try to use Static Grip after the enemy team has used it's disable spells or on the hero with the last unused disable in order to get a long-duration Static Grip.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_electrician_: Stay close to an allied disabler to prevent long-duration Static Grips.
Electrician is highly reliant on Electric Shield to deal damage, so reduce his mana by attacking him while it's up or burning his mana.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_emeraldwarde: Emerald Warden has very high sustained damage. Try to stay hidden behind allies and unleash your spells from a safe distance.
Set Overgrowth's near your tower to punish overaggressive enemies or use them for vision to avoid ganks.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_emeraldwarde: Hunter's Command has huge range and does not require sight. Retreat early to avoid an untimely death.
Overgrowths can be destroyed with 1-2 attacks if you get trapped in them.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_empath_1: A well-placed Illusory Veil can be the difference between life or death. You can also dodge incoming damage by jumping into an ally with As One.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_empath_2: If Essence link is about to expire anyway, break it by moving away for the extra stun.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_empath_1: Quickly focus down Empath before she's able to enter an ally with As One. If she successfully combines, kill her target to cause her to pop out. Empath is very vulnerable alone.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_empath_2: Break Essence Link early or not at all to avoid taking both the damage and the stun.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_engineer_1: Try to land The Keg on yourself and pursuing enemies to stun them while building distance. Unleashing Energy Field can slow surrounding enemies to a crawl.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_engineer_2: Knock back targets trying to run out of Energy Field with The Keg.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_engineer_1: Attack the Engineer's gadgets to prevent them from dealing too much damage. Be wary of being led into Spider Mine traps.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_engineer_2: Be aware of Engineer's mana and position to get an idea when and where he's placing Spider Mines.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_fayde_1: Use Burning Shadows to stun assailants. While using Reflection, be mindful of enemies that are carrying stealth detection.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_fayde_2: Use the treewalking of Reflection to surprise enemies that have stealth detection.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_fayde_1: Keep good map awareness and buy Ward of Revelations to prevent Fayde from taking you by surprise.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_fayde_2: Buy hit point items such as Fortified Bracers and magic armor such as Mystic Vestments to keep Fayde from killing you with her burst magic damage.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_flintbeastwo: Flint Beastwood is best played in the back lines of a fight dealing damage from afar while his teammates occupy the enemy team.
Explosive Flare does damage to buildings and can be used to finish off towers enemies are trying to deny.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_flintbeastwo: Flint Beastwood does very good damage from a long distance, but has little ways to escape if you get close to him.
Look to gank Flint Beastwood early and often.  He is an easy target without an escape and he scales very well into late game if allowed to farm.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_flux_1: Activate Discharge while in purple mode to push all enemies away.  Building strength on Flux not only increases his survivability, but increases the damage of Magnetic Surge.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_flux_2: Discharge can be used to reveal stealthed enemy heroes that would otherwise get away.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_flux_1: A Nullstone will protect you from a global Discharge.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_flux_2: Scatter from your teammates fast after a Discharge because it's usually followed up by many area of effect spells.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_forsakenarch: When escaping, predict your opponents' movements with Crippling Volley.
Save up the Call of the Damned skeletal minions for when you can push a tower or get into a fight. Click the ability to start stacking the minions and click it again to unleash them.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_forsakenarch: Piercing Arrows is cast from an illusion, but it can still be interrupted by a stun or silence.
Move erratically when you expect a Crippling Volley.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_gauntlet_1: Cast Grapple on an ally to move both him and yourself out of harm's way.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_gauntlet_2: Grapple can be used to hook in a hero or push both of you forward depending on how far you cast it.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_gauntlet_1: A Nullstone will protect you from Gauntlet Blast. Gauntlet's damage output is all magic damage, so buy magic armor to mitigate its effects.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_gauntlet_2: Be aware of Gauntlet's positioning to avoid being hooked or pushed into his tower range.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_geomancer_1: Use Dig to travel through unpathable terrain like cliffs and trees. Both Quicksand and Crystal Field can not only be placed on top of enemies, but in front of them as a deterrent.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_geomancer_2: You can cast spells while traveling underground with Dig.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_geomancer_1: When Crystal Field is placed, quickly move out of the way before it blows.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_geomancer_2: The pulsing damage from Earth's Grasp can be avoided if you can move fast enough. Marchers will help keep you ahead of them.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_frosty_1: Use Ice Imprisonment to shut down an assailant. You can also cast Ice Imprisonment on yourself to mitigate damage for the duration, then cast Glacial Downpour to slow and damage nearby enemies.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_frosty_2: Use Tundra Blast as Ice Imprisonment fades to avoid overlapping your disabling effects.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_frosty_1: Glacial Downpour is one of the most damaging spells in the game. Quickly interrupt him if he channels it.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_frosty_2: You can still cast spells while under the effect of Ice Imprisonment.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_gladiator_1: Try to position Pitfall to predict your opponent's movements.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_gladiator_2: Positioning is important for maximizing the number of enemies hit by Flagellation.  An Assassin Shroud can help you position as well as give a damage boost to the Flagellation attack.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_gladiator_1: Move perpendicular to Gladiator to avoid being caught in Flagellation's radius.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_gladiator_2: Gladiator's spells have a long delay, so move erratically to avoid them.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_goldenveil_1: Recluse is useful as a ward spotting tool. If Goldenveil loses his regeneration and no enemy is visible, they may have planted a ward nearby.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_goldenveil_2: Ganking targets with more tokens not only causes Greedgutter to deal more damage, but also yields the highest gold reward for Goldenveil and his team.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_goldenveil_1: Goldenveil is squishy and must be in melee range to perform his combo. Use this opportuity to burst him down before he can escape back into the trees.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_goldenveil_2: Destroying trees not only limits the places Goldenveil can hide, but also stuns and reveals him if you destroy the tree he is perched on.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_hammerstorm_: Save Hammer Throw for initiating, killing, and escaping. Proper use of the ability will determine how a team fight proceeds.
Buying a Portal Key will help you initiate fights without time for enemies to spread away from your area of effect stun.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_hammerstorm_: Move away from allies when Hammerstorm performs a Hammer Throw. Crowd control is very powerful when trying to avoid the boosted autoattacks during his Brute Strength.
Buying and using a Void Talisman can be very effective at keeping yourself alive if a Hammerstorm is beating on you with Brute Strength.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_hellbringer_: Summon Malphas should generally be saved to initiate. However, its wide stun is great as an escape tool.
Remember that Malphas deals area of effect magic damage and bonus damage to buildings.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_hellbringer_: The stun and damage from Summon Malphas are unavoidable. However, Malphas can be instantly destroyed with Nullfire Blade.
Buy magic armor to offset the reduction from Demonic Touch.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_ichor_1: Transfusion is best used to save an ally, but can also be used as a clutch escape in dire situations.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_ichor_2: The lower your health is, the more you heal from Life Leech. Don't be afraid to stay and fight!
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_ichor_1: If Transfusion is making enemy heroes too tanky, use the opportunity to kill Ichor first, destroying the link and their increased defenses.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_ichor_2: Bloodrush greatly reduces your team's auto-attack potential; try bursting him down with magic if he activates it.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_jereziah_1: By casting Protective Charm and Sol's Blessing, you will become effectively invulnerable for the duration.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_jereziah_2: A timely Inner Light can quickly swing a fight in your favor.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_jereziah_1: Buy a Nullfire Blade or use a dispel ability to remove Jeraziah's powerful buffs.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_jereziah_2: Try to take out Jeraziah first before he can get off Sol's Blessing or scare him into using it early and re-engage after it fades.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_kingklout_1: Parade of Power can hit twice if you send it through someone and then use the ability again!
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_kingklout_2: Using your abilities offensively against enemy heroes will quickly build up and proc Conscription.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_kingklout_1: When you see a Parade of Power coming, move quickly! The ability is easy to dodge, but punishing if it hits you!
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_kingklout_2: Getting close to King Klout can get you in trouble when he casts Bluster. Be careful when next to him!
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_treant_1: Save Nature's Veil for either initiation or escape. If in trouble, do not hesitate to cast Root and immobilize enemies in a wide area.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_treant_2: If the enemy team has stealth detection, buying a Portal Key can get you in position to catch them with Root.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_treant_1: Casting Shrunken Head, Nullfire Blade, Geometer's Bane, or another magic immunity or dispel will instantly remove Root. Buy stealth detection to prevent him from ambushing your team.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_treant_2: Items such as Shieldbreaker and Hellflower are great ways to help kill enemy tank heroes like Keeper of the Forest.  Nullfire Blade can also help by removing his Nature's Veil.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_kane_1: Waylay can be used in many ways. From catching players off guard to wiping out creep waves for a quick farm and push.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_kane_2: If you are taking a lot of damage during the laning phase try keeping Balance of Power set to Defense so you can increase your base armor making enemies have a harder time harrassing you out of lane.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_kane_1: Remember you can use your ultimate to call out a tower to force it to attack you. When doing this with your Steel Resolve you can tank a tower for your creeps and take very little damage.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_kane_2: Putting an early point in steel resolve will go a long way in putting you ahead in any 1 versus 1 fight.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_kraken_1: Use Tsunami Charge to escape from enemies. Torrent can also be used to slow assailants.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_kraken_2: Release the Kraken has a 1 second delay.  Predict where your enemies will run to catch them in it.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_kraken_1: Don't sandwich yourself between Kraken and a wall or tree. When he Releases the Kraken, furiously click away from the center of the beast. If you touch the center, you will be stunned.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_kraken_2: Tablet of Command is great way to save yourself or a teammate from Release the Kraken.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_legionnaire_: Buy a Portal Key! It's essential for initiating and escaping.
Right clicking on an enemy hero will get enemy creeps to attack you and activate Whirling Blade.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_legionnaire_: Stay a safe distance from allies to avoid a powerful Taunt. Keep your health high to avoid being Decapitated.
Don't go near friendly creeps when a Legionnaire is trying to attack you. Friendly creeps will only cause Legionnaire to whirl more often, hastening your death.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_scar_1: When using Stalk to harass, always time it so that you are in a safe position when it expires. Barrel Roll is a great tool for slowing multiple assailants drastically.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_scar_2: A well-timed Barrel Roll can be used to dodge spells while rolling.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_scar_1: Buy stealth detection to prevent Madman from sneaking away with Stalk. His viability decreases dramatically when he loses the element of surprise.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_scar_2: Stalk will do damage and make a sound as it passes through each enemy unit which allows you to have an idea where Madman is despite being invisible.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_javaras_1: Pick your targets wisely. Use Flash only when you can be assured to survive. Your quick movespeed allows you to chase enemies down without the need for Flash, so save it whenever possible for a quick escape. Flash can also be used to hide behind unpathable terrain, such as cliffs and trees.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_javaras_2: An early Helm of the Black Legion can be a great way to boost your low hit points and survive the early game.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_javaras_1: Focus Magebane early to prevent him from farming. Late game, purchase a Nullstone to prevent his Mana Rift from instantly killing you when you are depleted of mana.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_javaras_2: If a hero on your team is missing a significant amount of mana, scatter away from him before Mana Rift is cast.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_magmar_1: A well-timed Lava Surge can allow you to dodge projectiles and travel through cliffs.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_magmar_2: Use Steam Bath to quickly hide from sight, then travel in an unpredictable direction to escape. It also disjoints projectiles aimed at you.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_magmar_1: Interrupt Magmus before he can channel Eruption. Spread your team out to avoid being caught in Lava Surge.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_magmar_2: Buy stealth detection to prevent Magmus from getting away with Steam Bath.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_maliken_1: Send your Sword Throw in one direction, then travel in another direction to force assailants to split up.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_maliken_2: Buy a Shrunken Head to keep yourself from being stunned while you heal by attacking with Life Essence when focused.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_maliken_1: When Maliken uses Sword Throw, follow the sword to preempt his teleport.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_maliken_2: Maliken must be focused down or he may heal back up with Life Essence and the increased attack speed from Hellbourne Zeal.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_martyr_1: Guardian Angel will lower your life if the target you placed it on is taking damage. Decide whether or not to use it before or after using Hand in Hand, as it can be used to save a low health ally if you are full health, or save you if you are low health.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_martyr_2: Use Retribution after the enemy heroes cast their spells on you. Keep low hit points if you want to try to gank with Martyr.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_martyr_1: Martyr's Retribution deals more damage the less health he has. Be prepared to deal with this damage if you decide to focus him, or make sure that he doesn't get a chance to cast it before he dies.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_martyr_2: Martyr's Hand in Hand is a channeled ability. You should interrupt it to prevent him from healing.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_masterofarms: Use Master's Call in its appropriate form to get out of trouble.
Keep map and team awareness because Master's Call has global range and the ability to save a teammate across the map.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_masterofarms: Focus down Master of Arms quickly. He has very high damage output but typically very low health.
Don't stand in the Acid Bomb.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_midas_1: Use Golden Salvo and Lion's Pride as the primary components of your combo. Save Elemental Warp to escape or get the final hit.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_midas_2: Elemental Warp applies Reagent also at your starting location, so use Golden Salvo after Elemental Warping away as a secondary combo.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_midas_1: Avoid being hit by two of Midas' spells in a short window. Move erratically to dodge his skill shots.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_midas_2: Midas does primarily magic damage. Buy magic armor such as Mystic Vestments to help you survive his spells.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_mimix_1: Your potential isn't limited to the illusions created by Schism; Geometer's Bane and Illusion runes can give you a power spike when your ultimate is down.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_mimix_2: Wall of Mirrors can be used as a pseudo-escape in case of emergencies by targeting an enemy and running through your own walls.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_mimix_1: Xemplar's illusions are his main source of damage, so destroy them with an Arcane Bomb or some AOE spells as quickly as possible.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_mimix_2: Silencing Xemplar or depleting his mana will cause him to lose his main forms of burst damage and initiation.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_moira_1: Use Ephemeral Forge to get yourself in a good position to use your abilities, leaving yourself out of harm's way.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_moira_2: Cast Shards of Harkon on yourself or an ally right before entering your Arcane Overload! The Shards will stun when you exit the ability.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_moira_1: Kill the Illusion created by Ephemeral Forge quickly. It takes 250% bonus damage and gives you gold and experience when you kill it!
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_moira_2: Remember if you have Mana Sunder cast on you, you lose all of your Mana again if you use an ability for its duration. Wait until it's over to combo spells together!
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_monarch_1: Cast Chrysalis when you're being focused. Cast Cleansing Wind before you emerge to give yourself a big boost of speed and remove any debuffs.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_monarch_2: Keep back in team fights so you don't get focused down before you can use your reactive spells to save your team.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_monarch_1: Because Monarch can remove disables from allies, focusing her first will prevent her from unleashing her reactive spells.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_monarch_2: Switch targets from someone with Chrysalis unless you can burst it down to finish the target off.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_monkeyking_1: Illusive Dash and Heavenly Vault allow you to travel great distances in a short amount of time. Casting Heavenly Vault on a Thousand Jin Slam will propel you across terrain, including cliffs and trees.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_monkeyking_2: Using Heavenly Vault on buildings will propel you farther.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_monkeyking_1: Prevent Monkey King from entering Heavenly Vault distance, as it is the most common start to his combo. Stay out of the second Thousand Jin Slam explosion.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_monkeyking_2: Buy armor and hit point items to keep Monkey King from killing you with his combo.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_krixi_1: Lead assailants into secluded areas so you can kill them with Moon Finale. Use the mini-stun from Moon Beam to facilitate chasing.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_krixi_2: Play carefully while you don't have Moon Finale available. Enemies will be looking to kill you because of your low hit points and lack of escape.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_krixi_1: Moon Finale does a huge amount of damage to individual targets, so stay close to allied units and heroes to distribute its power.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_krixi_2: Look to gank Moon Queen early and often. She is an easy target without an escape and she scales very well into late game if allowed to farm.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_moraxus_1: Cast Matraxe to shield yourself from incoming damage. It will also prevent a Portal Key from going on cooldown!
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_moraxus_2: Buy a Portal Key to get in a good position for devastating Quake stuns on grouped enemies.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_moraxus_1: Attack Moraxus when Matraxe is activated to prevent it from building up damage.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_moraxus_2: Move erratically to avoid More Axes.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_hydromancer_: Save Waveform for escapes. The bonus health from Forced Evolution can help you tank damage as you escape. After you've created some distance, Magic Carp can force an assailant to stop momentarily or be stunned.
Combo Weed Field onto a target as it's about to get hit by Magic Carp to ensure it hits.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_hydromancer_: Always stop right as Magic Carp is about to impact. Tight control of your hero will allow you to ignore its stun and dodge Weed Field simultaneously.
If you find Myrmidon is dealing too much damage while in Forced Evolution, buy magic armor to mitigate its damage.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_hantumon_1: Pounce may be cast on allies in order to get you out of a tight situation. It is also best to fight an enemy who is under your Smoke Bomb, as he will be extremely hindered if he tries to fight back.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_hantumon_2: A Nullfire Blade can be used to keep your target in your Smoke Bomb or to dispel Dust of Revelation from yourself.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_hantumon_1: Night Hound is permanently stealthed after he learns Invisibility. Buy stealth detection to avoid being ambushed.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_hantumon_2: Night Hound deals bonus damage with Backstab if he attacks from behind. Try to avoid running from him whenever possible.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_nitro_1: Ballistic can be activated while moving, use this ability to kite your enemies and make you a harder target to hit.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_nitro_2: Try to save Runaround for when you get heavily engaged upon as it can allow for enough time to escape or win a fight.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_nitro_1: Divide & Conquer grants Ballistic additional damage the further you are away from Nitro, try to stay close to her when combating Nitro.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_nitro_2: HEAT Rounds require 3 stacks before it does damage, try to let stacks expire before reengaging Nitro.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_nomad_1: Nomad has a variety of tools to assist an escape. Use a mixture of Sandstorm and Mirage Strike to keep yourself invisible. A well-timed Edge Counter can also allow you to dodge potentially lethal damage while stunning its inflictor.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_nomad_2: Finishing off an enemy will reset Mirage Strike's cooldown.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_nomad_1: Buy armor to offset Nomad's powerful True and Mirage Strikes. Try to fake attacks and spellcasts to cause him to waste Edge Counter.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_nomad_2: Buy stealth detection to prevent Nomad from sneaking away with Mirage Strike and Sandstorm.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_fairy_1: Use Volatile Pod and Grace of the Nymph to keep yourself and allies at full health and mana. Use Teleport to escape when surrounded if your opponents do not have an interrupt.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_fairy_2: Good use of Wards of Sight will allow you to use Teleport to set up ganks safely.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_fairy_1: Keep good map awareness to prevent being ambushed by Nymphora and her allies using Teleport.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_fairy_2: Take Nymphora out quickly to prevent her from keeping allies refueled with Volatile Pod and Grace of the Nymph.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_ophelia_1: Try to micromanage your Commanded units to block assailants as you escape. Activate Ophelia's Touch to heal yourself when in trouble.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_ophelia_2: Creeps have activated abilities you should try to micromanage.  For example, Minotaurs can stun around themselves with Body Slam and Skeleton Kings can immobilize with The King's Grip.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_ophelia_1: Focus Ophelia first to prevent her support spells from being unleashed.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_ophelia_2: Wiping out Ophelia's minions with area of effect spells can set back her ganking ability for a couple of minutes.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_panda_1: Cannon Ball can launch you over unpathable terrain like cliffs and trees. If facing a lone assailant, casting Flick, then Face Smash, and following up with your other abilities can make quick work of him before he has a chance to react.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_panda_2: Pandamonium can be mana limited and items like Nullstone or Blood Chalice can help him cast all his spells.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_panda_1: Buy a Nullstone to prevent Face Smash. A Void Talisman will allow you to dodge all of Pandamonium's abilities for the duration.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_panda_2: Move erratically if you expect a Cannon Ball incoming.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_parasite_1: Infesting a creep when you are in trouble is a great way to escape, especially if it is a catapult because it will grant you magic immunity.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_parasite_2: You may want to save the best creeps you find to gank enemy heroes.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_parasite_1: When Parasite is Infesting a creep, his hero dot will not appear on the mini-map.  Be on the lookout for rogue creep dots on the mini-map that may be Parasite.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_parasite_2: Parasite does high burst magic damage.  Buy magic armor such as Mystic Vestments to help survive his burst damage.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_rocky_1: A Portal Key is core in order to get in and out of battle! Activate Stalagmites, then Chuck, for maximum damage.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_rocky_2: When in trouble, you can Chuck an enemy hero away from you to a farther enemy.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_rocky_1: Buy magic armor to mitigate the powerful damage combo of Stalagmites and Chuck.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_rocky_2: Don't let Pebbles walk up to you, or his Stalagmites, then Chuck combo will do it's maximum damage.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_pestilence_1: Use Impale to stun enemies, then use Flight to run away.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_pestilence_2: Buy a Portal Key to get in position for devastating Impale stuns on grouped enemies.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_pestilence_1: Buy armor to offset the negative effects of Swarm.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_pestilence_2: Spread out as Pestilence approaches to prevent multiple teammates from being stunned.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_mumra_1: Use Wall of Mummies at a choke point, then attack one of the mummies to escape and block off assailants.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_mumra_2: Use Tormented Soul to get vision of areas or to help kill an enemy across the map.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_mumra_1: Avoid being caught in Wall of Mummies. A Tablet of Command can push you out without taking any damage.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_mumra_2: When low in health, travel in unconventional paths to avoid being sniped by Tormented Soul.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_diseasedride: Plague Carrier is best used in team fights and when enemies are close together so that it may bounce multiple times.
Remember to keep Cursed Shield on yourself and allies as often as possible to negate damage.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_diseasedride: Once Plague Carrier is launched, immediately scatter from all nearby allies to mitigate its bouncing potential.
Avoid fighting Plague Rider away from allied creeps when he has Plague Carrier available.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_parallax_1: Lining up Iconic Dash to hit an enemy hero will reset the cooldown, allowing you to immediately dash again.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_parallax_2: Make sure to purchase items that increase your Max Mana as it will cause both Fulcrum Shift and Earthshatter to do more damage.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_parallax_1: Killing Parallax causes him to lose Max Mana charges; try to focus him to help stop Earthshatter from doing massive damage.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_parallax_2: Silencing Parallax while Earthshatter is active will stop it from doing damage for the duration of the silence.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_pollywogprie: You can trap an opponent, or yourself, in Voodoo Wards. Cast his disables before and after to delay and possibly kill them!
Try to use Tongue Tied after the enemy team has used it's disable spells or on the hero with the last unused disable in order to get a long-duration Tongue Tied.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_pollywogprie: If trapped in Voodoo Wards, don't panic! Attack them to carve a path out.
Stay close to an allied disabler to prevent long-duration Tongue Tied.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_predator_1: Predator's Carnivorous affords him a huge amount of life leech. Even if your health is low, activating Stone Hide and autoattacking will often keep you alive long enough for your allies to arrive, or may even net you a kill.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_predator_2: Items that give you speed or slow the enemy can help you stay on your target and leech life.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_predator_1: Predator lacks an interrupt. Carry a Homecoming Stone to easily escape. Buying additional armor will also help to mitigate the effects of Terror.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_predator_2: A Void Talisman can be an effective counter to a Predator attacking you.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_puppetmaster: Puppet Show is only effective if the target is standing near another unit.
Use Voodoo Puppet when an enemy is escaping so that you may attack the puppet instead of chasing after the enemy.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_puppetmaster: Puppet Show will only affect you if you are near another unit.
The only way to escape the Voodoo Puppet is to move out of its range.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_pyromancer_1: Due to the large cast time of Dragonfire, you will need to lead your opponents in order to land the ability.  Use all three of your abilities in unison on one target to deal massive damage.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_pyromancer_2: Hitting at least one attack or spell every three seconds will keep stacking Burning on an enemy hero.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_pyromancer_1: Pyromancer's stun, Dragonfire, has a long cast time. Try to guess where he may cast it and move to avoid it and the extra consequent damage he will inflict afterward.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_pyromancer_2: Nullstone will prevent Pyromancer from casting Blazing Strike on you. He has no other single target spells to remove the Nullstone protection.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_rampage_1: Activating Might of the Herd can slow nearby enemies, assisting an escape. When Horned Strike is off cooldown, attack them to push them away.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_rampage_2: After hitting an enemy with Stampede, you can run to the other side to try and Horned Strike him back towards your team.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_rampage_1: Buy armor to offset Rampage's powerful spike damage. Keep good map awareness to know when he's performing Stampede on you.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_rampage_2: A Nullstone can prevent Rampage from charging you or using The Chains That Bind on you. A Tablet of Command can separate Rampage from his dragged target.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_revenant_1: Always have at least one point in Essence Shroud so that you or an ally can escape from a bad situation when needed.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_revenant_2: Defile can be cast on yourself or allies to amplify attacks by adding magic damage and a slow effect. Combined with the lowered magic armor from Mortification, Defile can unload serious damage.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_revenant_1: Due to Essence Shroud, Revenant may escape and initiate from stealth.  When fighting him, carry stealth detection so he cannot easily escape.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_revenant_2: Mortification lowers your magic armor, picking up some extra magic armor from Mystic Vestments or going for Shrunken Head can help prevent this.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_rhapsody_1: Make sure you are in a safe place when using Protective Melody, as you will be the only one on your team vulnerable in the area.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_rhapsody_2: Use Disco Inferno when you want to stand and fight. It won't help you if you continue running.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_rhapsody_1: You only take damage from Disco Inferno if you are standing still in it.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_rhapsody_2: Disable or burst down Rhapsody when she uses Protective Melody because it will make the rest of her surrounding team nearly invulnerable.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_riptide_1: Harrassing an enemy with your Watery Grave can quickly force your enemy out of the lane, leaving it free for you to farm!
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_riptide_2: Remember, whenever you are in water you move fast and can go invisible if no enemies are near you, making it a great tool for escaping when you have to.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_riptide_1: When Riptide is on land she is very weak and can lose most encounters. Wait for her to use his ultimate and when its over go hunting for her!
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_riptide_2: Riptide gains strength against you while you are on water, avoid going toe to toe with her in the river, and remember you can always try to lose her in the jungle.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_sandwraith_1: For 3 seconds after you move off of Desert's Curse sand trail, you retain the ability to move through any terrain; use this as an escape mechanism.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_sandwraith_2: You can use Mirage and Manifest on a surprised enemy to escape from a gank.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_sandwraith_1: Sand Wraith can teleport to any of his illusions his ultimate creates. Be ready for him to jump on you at any time.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_sandwraith_2: Gank Sand Wraith early and often because he becomes very difficult to deal with later in the game.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_sapphire_1: A properly placed Unstable Shard can not only slow enemies, but block paths to ensure that they cannot get away from you, or advance toward you
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_sapphire_2: Crystallize can be used not only to setup a teamfight, but also to reset a fight or gank that is not going in your favor.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_sapphire_1: Destroying the Unstable Shard or removing Sapphire's Quickshield can hinder her offense greatly.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_sapphire_2: Leaving an initiator outside of Sapphire's ultimate range can counter her attempts to setup a teamfight.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_scout_1: Use Electric Eyes to silence nearby enemies before escaping with Vanish. Always be mindful of whether enemies are carrying stealth detection.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_scout_2: Use Electric Eyes to keep vision on runes, counter Wards of Sight, or block creep spawns in the enemy team's neutral camps.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_scout_1: Buy stealth detection to avoid the Scout's flurry out of Vanish and destroy Electric Eyes before he can activate them. Seek him out and kill him early to prevent him from farming.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_scout_2: Vanish has a cooldown after coming out of stealth. You have a chance to burst down Scout when he comes out before he can Vanish again.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_silhouette_1: Send Shadow to explore an escape path, then switch positions with it if you are in trouble.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_silhouette_2: Tree Grapple's long range makes it excellent for escaping across cliffs.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_silhouette_1: Be careful when dealing with Silhouette's skill-shots, both the Tree Grapple and Death Lotus. To some extent you can see them coming and avoid them.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_silhouette_2: Keep track of Relentless Salvo stacks. Silhouette does more damage when she is able to sustain attacks on you.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_skrap_1: Zoomerang can be used to gather morsels that are too dangerous to grab. Line it up to hit enemy heroes during this ability for extra harass.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_skrap_2: Clear creep waves with Skrap's spells before Vorax gets to them to keep Vorax from slowing down during a push.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_skrap_1: Vorax continues to gain health as long as Skrap feeds him morsels. Eliminating Skrap during pushes ensures Vorax doesn't grow too powerful.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_skrap_2: Vorax is visible as soon as he spawns. Use this information to rally your team at the location you think will be in the most danger.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_ebulus_1: Use Toxin Wards defensively to scout incoming ganks. Poison Spray coupled with Poison Burst is often enough of a deterrent to force a retreat.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_ebulus_2: Buy items that will help you stay alive in a team fight and try to get Poison Burst and Toxicity on as many enemy heroes as possible.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_ebulus_1: Slither lacks an interrupt. Carry a Homecoming Stone if he poisons you to avoid death.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_ebulus_2: You should try to deny any teammate dying to Slither's damage over time abilities to prevent Slither from getting the gold and experience.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_helldemon_1: Try to cast your Judgment so that it hits enemies. Casting it as often as possible while escaping can allow you to turn the tide of battle.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_helldemon_2: You want to buy items that will allow you to stay alive long enough to get multiple Judgments off and have enough mana to use Demonic Execution if needed.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_helldemon_1: A Nullstone can nullify Soul Reaper's Demonic Execution. Magic armor will decrease the effectiveness of Soul Reaper's powerful spells.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_helldemon_2: Soul Reaper should be taken out early in a fight to keep him from using too many fight swinging Judgments.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_soulstealer_: Due to Soulstealer's ability to put out massive magic damage with Demon Hands by lining them up properly, he is able to turn the tides of battle when least expected.
