It is also important to remember that Soul Burst deals more damage the more souls you have and the closer you are to your enemies.
Use Demon Hands to clear groups creeps and regain souls after a death.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_soulstealer_: Soulstealer's Demon Hands are cast in an area in front of him, be sure to watch out for when he is facing you and move perpendicularly to avoid it.
When Soulstealer uses his ultimate, Soul Burst, it is best to get as far away from him as possible, as it does more damage the closer you are to him.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_succubis_1: Use Mesmerize on targets who are not getting focused by your allies. Any ally who attacks the target will get the debuff put on them instead.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_succubis_2: Make sure you are in a safe place when using Succubus' Hold to get a long duration hold.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_succubis_1: It is best to approach Succubus with an ally so you do not get locked down by her channeling disable ultimate.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_succubis_2: Right clicking your ally can swap Mesmerize onto yourself so your teammate can escape.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_hiro_1: Use Blade Frenzy's magic immunity properties to your advantage. The duration is long enough to channel Homecoming Stone for a quick escape.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_hiro_2: Try to catch enemies alone from allied units for an easy kill with Swift Slashes.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_hiro_1: Swift Slashes does a huge amount of damage to individual targets, so stay close to allied units and heroes to distribute its power.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_hiro_2: Blade Frenzy does a huge amount of magic damage if you are close to Swiftblade. Keep your distance from him or have a way to escape if he activates it.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_tempest_1: Tempest can use Elemental to kill neutral creeps in the woods which typically keeps you out of harms way. Also the combination of Meteor and Elemental Void can turn the tides of any game if you catch the enemy team within it, but the enemy team knows this and will try to kill you first! Pick your times carefully of when to go in.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_tempest_2: Buy a Portal Key to catch the enemy team grouped with a devastating Elemental Void.  Be sure to catch enemy disablers in it or your ultimate won't last.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_tempest_1: Tempest's stun, Glacial Blasts, will not trigger if he cannot see you, try to fog him!
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_tempest_2: Elemental Void is one of the most powerful ultimates in the game, but it is also channeling; make sure your team has a stun or disable ready to stop his channeling.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_kunas_1: Thunderbringer's spells have very high cast ranges. Stay behind allies or trees to conceal yourself while dishing out damage.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_kunas_2: Use Blast of Lighting and Lightning Storm to reveal stealthed units.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_kunas_1: Be mindful of your health! When Lightning Storm is available, always retreat early.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_kunas_2: Buy Magic Armor to mitigate Thunderbringer's spell damage.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_xalynx_1: Buy health so you can sustain yourself amidst a battle. Aim Chain Reaction slightly ahead of enemies to make up for the cast delay.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_xalynx_2: If you find yourself mana limited, save leveling Torment for later when you have a bigger mana pool.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_xalynx_1: Disabling Torturer will also stop Torment from being cast. Do not allow him to wedge himself between your team; he does the most damage when everyone is grouped closely.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_xalynx_2: Torturer does huge amounts of area of effect damage and should be taken out quickly.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_tremble_1: Micromanage Boris to slow and immobilize your assailants while you run. Place Terror Mounds along the way to boost your speed.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_tremble_2: Set Terror Mounds at base and in enemy territory to be able to quickly Terror Port to base or to gank.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_tremble_1: Tremble lacks an interrupt. Carrying a Homecoming Stone can allow you to escape death.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_tremble_2: Destroy Tremble's Terror Mounds whenever you can, but be careful of doing it alone as he can Terror Port to it and kill you.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_tundra_1: Micromanage Coeurl to slow assailants while you escape. Use Avalanche to stun and slow them if necessary.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_tundra_2: Be sure to cast Piercing Shards ahead where you expect the enemy to run because it has a travel time.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_tundra_1: Kill Coeurl quickly to avoid being slowed. Buying a Nullstone can help prevent Tundra's powerful Avalanche stun.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_tundra_2: Move perpendicularly to avoid Piercing Shards.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_valkyrie_1: Save Courageous Leap for escaping. Use the stealth provided by Prism to escape in unpredictable fashion.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_valkyrie_2: A Javalin of Light thrown from an unexpected angle has a much better chance of landing.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_valkyrie_1: Valkyrie has very strong initiation tools. Avoid being ambushed by a Prismed team by purchasing stealth detection.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_valkyrie_2: Keep on the move and keep your eyes peeled for Javelin of Light, as it can stun you up to five seconds based on how far it has traveled.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_vindicator_1: Time Final Chapter to disrupt enemy spells, especially channeling abilities.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_vindicator_2: Vindicator is very vulnerable alone, so stay behind allies to support and dish out damage.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_vindicator_1: Vindicator's damage output and utility are near unparalleled, but he moves slowly and generally has low health. Focus him first to take him out of the battle.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_vindicator_2: A Nullstone will protect you from a global Final Chapter.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_voodoo_1: Mojo heals you over time. Sometimes placing Mojo on yourself slightly early can end up keeping you alive in the long run.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_voodoo_2: Make sure you are in a safe place when using Spirit Ward in order to have it up for a long duration.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_voodoo_1: Cursed Ground is Voodoo Jester's primary source of damage, as it amplifies other damage sources. Avoid standing still or being stunned to dodge its long cast time.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_voodoo_2: Voodoo Jester can dish out a lot of physical damage by channeling Spirit Ward. Interrupt him quickly to avoid further damage!
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_wolfman_1: Metamorphosis allows you to travel at maximum movement speed and ignore all slow effects. Buying and using a Shrunken Head during Metamorphosis will allow you to attack or escape with near impunity.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_wolfman_2: Micromanage Hellhounds to stack multiple neutral camps at the same time to increase your farming output.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_wolfman_1: Warbeast is most vulnerable early game when he is farming. During Metamorphosis, he is extremely fast and powerful, so the best option is to lock him down with crowd control or simply back off and wait out the duration.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_wolfman_2: Buying and using a Void Talisman can keep you alive during War Beast's Metamorphosis.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_yogi_1: Bear Form gives Wildsoul a large amount of hit points and armor. Being in bear form will require a lot more resources to bring you down.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_yogi_2: Micromanage Booboo to Return to you and attack heroes chasing you in hopes of Entagling Claws immobilizing them.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_yogi_1: Focus on bringing down the main hero since this will also kill Wildsoul's bear Booboo. You may require the help of teammates since Booboo and Wildsoul together can take down most solo heroes.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_yogi_2: Wildsoul is most vulnerable early game when he is farming. Hunt for him in the enemy neutral camps if you can't find him.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_witchslayer_: Miniaturization is cast instantly, making it a very powerful initiation and counter-initiation tool.
Power Drain is great for taking off Nullstone protection or against lanes without disables.  It can also be used on creeps to replenish your mana.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_witchslayer_: Witch Slayer's Graveyard is extremely powerful when it hits more than one target. Try to stay far enough away from allies so both of you do not get hit.
Take out Witch Slayer early in team fights to keep him from using his multiple crowd control abilities on your team.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_babayaga_1: It is best not to use Flash of Darkness needlessly, as it is very important to use as an escape mechanism.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_babayaga_2: Try to save Bat Blast for when you can hit multiple enemies.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_babayaga_1: Clumping up as a team when facing Wretched Hag can be lethal because she may blink in at a moment's notice and deal large amounts of area of effect damage.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_babayaga_2: You want to disable and burst down Wretched Hag in order to kill her before she gets away with Flash of Darkness.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_zephyr_1: Consume your cyclones manually to heal yourself in order to keep you in the fight for longer.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_zephyr_2: It's good to drop Typhoon on top of enemies and then Gust them back in as they try to escape.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_zephyr_1: Zephyr does a lot of magic damage over time in an area around him, good counters are to stay out of the range of his cyclones or buy a Mystic Vestements.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_zephyr_2: Items such as Shieldbreaker and Hellflower are great ways to help kill enemy tank heroes such as Zephyr.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_berserker_1: Build protective items because Strength Sap and Carnage will allow you to do plenty of damage if you can stay in the middle of a fight.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_berserker_2: Mark for Death's cooldown resets whenever the target is killed. Be sure to cast it on your next target in the heat of battle.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_berserker_1: Berzerker deals a lot of damage and gains resistance to stuns, debuffs, and disables while Carnage is active; however, he also takes increased damage for the duration. Be sure to focus him down quickly!
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_berserker_2: Berzerker deals only physical damage, even with his abilities, making high armor or Void Talisman important for surviving.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_blitz_1: Blitz's main source of damage comes from maximizing Blitzkrieg. Casting a Lightning Shackles or Pilfering on the enemy or Quicking on yourself will greatly increase the damage done.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_blitz_2: Quicken can be cast on yourself or allies to initiate or chase enemies down. Using it defensively can often be the difference between saving an ally or letting them down.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_blitz_1: Blitz deals a high amount of burst damage however is very fragile. Strike first with a disable and you can shut him down before he gets any abilities off.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_blitz_2: Quicken grants a significant movespeed burst, but does not provide any slow resistance. Stacking slows on a Quickened target will still cripple them to a crawl.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_ravenor_1: Ball Lightning deals a lot of damage and allows you to teleport to the enemy, but can be difficult to hit. Try using it when in melee range or waiting for an ally to disable the target.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_ravenor_2: Power Overwhelming will deal increasing damage throughout a fight, focus on survivability items like Helm of the Black Legion that allow you to keep on your target.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_ravenor_1: Ball Lightning is a very dangerous skill allowing Ravenor to teleport and stun you after it hits. The ability moves very slowly and only in a straight line, move aside when you see it!
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_ravenor_2: Ravenor deals increasing damage with Power Overwhelming whenever he hits a target. Spread out to avoid him building up charges too quickly.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_artesia_1: Artesia has an extremely short cooldown on her Arcane Missile but expends her mana very quickly. Be sure to pickup heavy mana items like Ring of Sorcery.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_artesia_2: Essence Projection can be relocated after it's been placed, use this to maintain strong positioning throughout a fight.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_artesia_1: Artesia deals a lot of long range magic damage but is also very fragile with no escape abilities. Initiate on her and she'll be dead before any of her damage goes out.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_artesia_2: Essence Projection heals Artesia's allies in combat while also firing Arcane Missiles. Be sure to attack it down quickly whenever you see it.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_prophet_1: Prophet's strength is in his team fight presence, amplifying the damage his enemies receive. Invigorate also heals for a small amount boosting attack speed and has a short cooldown.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_prophet_2: Shared Fate can be used to slow enemies and propagate all of your spell effects and attacks. Be sure to place a Shared Fate before using your abilities.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_prophet_1: Prophet's debuffs can be devastating, but last a short duration. Try to avoid being damaged while under the effect of Debilitate and Persecution.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_prophet_2: Shared Fate will cause you and your allies to be affected by all of Prophet's abilities and attacks. Try to avoid staying in this zone unless Prophet's abilities are already on cooldown.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_plant_1: Rejuvenating growth can be used to help allies in other lanes if they are struggling or to strengthen their lane presence further.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_plant_2: Corrosive Pods cause allies to copy your casts of Spore Breath. You can use this to coordinate hero kills when they need a bit of extra help to take an enemy down.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_plant_1: Spore Breath stuns enemies at the end, but does not slow while dealing its damage. Try to disable Bramble and get away to avoid the stun.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_plant_2: Entangling Vine Wall deals large amounts of damage but has a short attack range. Try running outwards and avoid running alongside it.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_ellonia_1: Ellonia can deal significant damage throughout a fight, but expends alot of mana. Be sure to pick up heavy intelligence or mana items such as Ring of Sorcery.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_ellonia_2: Deep Freeze can deal devastating amounts of damage after building up stacks of frost. Try to use it as a finisher or lock enemies in place for your spells.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_ellonia_1: Ellonia deals a lot of damage and slow, but her abilities are easily dodged. Avoid standing still at all costs!
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_ellonia_2: Frost does not last very long but will always refresh when hit by her abilities. If stacked up too high, try to outrange her and avoid fighting until it falls off.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_flamedragon_: Draconis can harass very well early game with Fiery Barrage. Be sure to put at least 1 point in this skill early on!
Draconis can use Cataclysm to engage in a teamfight where both teams have already committed. Enemies will burn faster from your damage this way!
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_flamedragon_: Draconic Defense can be used to stall a push quickly and gives Draconis' team the upper hand. Use this when your enemies have already committed to a push and your team is ready to follow up!
Draconic Defense can also be used to fly back to your ally fountain to heal yourself quickly and take a lesser cooldown penalty to the skill. Keep this option in mind throughout the game!
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_gunblade_1: Gunblade gains his survivability from his Demonic Shield. This scales with his agility allowing him to survive while receiving the damage benefits of Lethal Range.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_gunblade_2: Crippling Slugs and Grappling Shot both affect enemies through Magic Immunity.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_gunblade_1: Gunblade gains bonus damage for being close to you; try to keep your distance when attacking him.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_gunblade_2: Gunblade excels at killing a single target but is quite vulnerable to crowd control. Focus him down quickly if he tries to gain the benefits of his Lethal Range.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_artillery_1: LRM can be cast from an extremely long range, allowing Artillery to deal damage from a safe distance. While channeling, you can retarget the skill by activating it again.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_artillery_2: Mortar shot can slow enemies in a large area, more importantly the skill can be used while channeling LRM to land a few more shots.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_artillery_1: LRM is a channeling ability. Look to disable or silence him when he's channeling. Be careful, though, because he can continuously change which direction he is firing.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_artillery_2: Homing Missile can stun enemies for an extremely long duration but travels very slowly. Be sure to move away from your allies if you've been targetted by the missile!
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_kenisis_1: Inherent Defense allows Kinesis to gain more survivability for doing damage. Look to hit as many enemies as possible with Mass Control.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_kenisis_2: Kinesis is entirely environment dependent. Try to avoid fighting in rivers where there is a lack of trees.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_kenisis_1: Stasis Smash will damage and stun nearby enemies once complete. Try to avoid being too close to allies who are in the air.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_kenisis_2: Telekinetic Control can deal a lot of damage to one target, however it has a pretty significant downtime. Engage him before his burst becomes available again.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_taint_1: Defiling Touch is free damage and slows on attack; just be sure to walk over a corpse to throw it.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_taint_2: Zombie Apocolypse deals high damage to random targets in the area; catching someone alone will maximize your chance for a kill.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_taint_1: Gravekeeper can use Corpse Explosion to deal large amounts of Magic Damage in the area. Avoid standing near dead creeps.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_taint_2: Zombie Apocolypse deals high damage to random targets in the area; try to engage Gravekeeper with allies or pet summons to distribute the damage.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_riftmage_1: Cascade Event combined with Wormhole can be a devastating initiation. Be aware of the cast time on each ability to time it correctly.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_riftmage_2: Riftburn deals increasing damage while enemies are standing in it. Cascade Event and Shared Existence can be used to keep enemies inside.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_riftmage_1: Wormhole deals a large amount of Magic Damage and stuns enemies in the area. Be sure to interupt her before her channel completes.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_riftmage_2: Riftburn deals increasing damage in the area. Try to avoid standing in the area for too long.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_dreadknight_: Lord Salforis gains a large amount of health from hitting enemies with Life Tap. Be sure to hit an enemy before the duration wears off.
Enemies that die under the effects of Undying will also grant you bonus damage. Don't forget to consume the soul for some extra hit points if necessary.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_dreadknight_: Dark Lord's Presence is a passive that deals damage around Salforis split evenly among all nearby targets. Try not to be caught standing near him for too long, especially alone.
The Undying deals a large amount of damage over time and stops all healing and regeneration effects on the target, but is still affected by magic armor and damage absorbing abilities.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_rally_1: Rally can use compel both defensively and offensively. Be sure to push you or your allies out of any dire situation!
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_rally_2: Seismic Slam can deal a lot of damage but requires a short windup. Try saving it for when an enemy is disabled and immobile.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_rally_1: Rally's compel ability can be used to stun enemies, however the cooldown is very significant. Once his Compel ability is used, he makes for an easily focused target with no escape.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_rally_2: Rally's Seismic Slam can deal a lot of damage with one blow, but hits a small area in front of him and has a small windup. Be sure to interrupt him with disables if you see it casting.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_oogie_1: Primal Surge can be used to restore a lot of life and mana over time, but won't save you if you're already low. Try to use it early in team fights and take advantage of its long duration.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_oogie_2: Conflagrate will remain active and continue to drain mana even while disabled. Try to stay as close to enemies as possible.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_oogie_1: While Primal Surge is active, Oogie will restore mana when damaged and restore life when spending mana. Try to avoid attacking him if he is low on mana, unless you can disable him for the kill.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_oogie_2: Tar Quake has an extremely short cooldown, but costs an increasing amount of mana with every cast. Avoid running in normal patterns to dodge his nukes, then turn the fight when he is out of mana.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_solstice_1: Solstice's ultimate can be cast from significant range, but has a long channel time. Try to hide in trees or cliffs out of sight of your enemy when channeling.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_solstice_2: Solstice's Luminescence and Shadow Dash are invisible to the enemy, allowing you to stealth and stalk your prey ganking more effectively at night time.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_solstice_1: Solstice will charge during the day time and stun his target and enemies around it, try to stay away from allies being charged and even interrupt the charge if able.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_solstice_2: Solstice's ultimate has a significant channel time for its maximum effect. Interrupt her while she is channeling to cancel the effect entirely.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_pearl_1: Preservation can stop all damage from enemies outside. Focus on using your abilities to keep enemies from getting in.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_pearl_2: Soothing Presence restores more health over time the more allies are around you. Try to stay near your allies to maximize the effect.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_pearl_1: Pearl's Preservation bubble only stops damage from the outside, rush inside the area to deal full damage!
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_pearl_2: Asphyxiate will dispel all buffs and slow on the initial cast, then repeat the effect in an area. Try to stay away from allies that are affected by Asphyxiate.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_grinex_1: Shadow Step is a powerful setup tool however is difficult to land. Try sneaking up on your enemies when they're near trees or other heroes.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_grinex_2: Illusory Assault lasts for a short duration but can deal alot of damage if the enemy is in short range. Use it on enemies closeby that are disabled or slowed to maximize the damage.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_grinex_1: Grinex has a variety of invisibility tools at his disposal allowing him to initiate and escape very easily. Purchase items with true vision to track him down.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_grinex_2: Shadow Step can push you into trees or other heroes dealing alot of damage and stunning. Try standing in the middle of the lane to deny him the opportunity.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_lodestone_1: Headsmash can deal alot of damage to the enemy but also to yourself. Try to avoid using it unless you have some charges of Lodestone Plates or Shatterstorm buildup activate.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_lodestone_2: Shatterstorm strips enemies of all armor and magic armor but also yourself. Rocket Drill can be used to escape the fight until your defenses return.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_lodestone_1: Lodestone Plates reduces damage from a limited number of sources. Try hitting him with low damage abilities to eat the shields rotating around him.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_lodestone_2: Shatterstorm deals alot of aoe damage and puts a devastating debuff on you. Try avoiding the hero while he is building up then engage him after he explodes.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_bushwack_1: Bushwack is very good at kiting enemies away, use Sidestep to dash away from enemies then slow them with a quick Crippling Dart.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_bushwack_2: Jungle Toxin deals more damage the more times you hit a single enemy. Try to focus on one target to stack the poison high.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_bushwack_1: Bushwack has alot of mobility and can kite enemies very well however has very low hit points. Hit him with a quick disable like Kuldra's Sheepstick to prevent his use of Side Step.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_bushwack_2: Spliter Shot deals damage to enemies behind Bushwack's target. Try to avoid standing in a line with your allies to avoid the extra splash damage.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_salomon_1: Salomon gains a large amount of gold from killing creeps with his passive Wish For Wealth. To maximize this effect, be sure to clear a large number of creeps in a short period of time.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_salomon_2: Salomon's Ultimate is both a great offensive and defensive tool granting access to all new abilities. Keep in mind that the health pool of your main hero is untouched while this form is active.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_salomon_1: Cosmic Cleave hits a very wide area but is always a predetermined range. Rather than side stepping to dodge this skill, run directly forward or back.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_salomon_2: Salomon is a threat to be wary of in his ultimate form. His form however has a very limited lifepool that can be destroyed very quickly. Be sure to focus him down to mitigate his damage output.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_prisoner_1: Ball and Chain is easier to hit the further away enemies are. Try to avoid using your hook on enemies in close range unless they are disabled.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_prisoner_2: Prison Break can hit multiple enemies but also has a significant delay. Don't be too greedy trying to hit multiple enemies or you risk hitting none.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_prisoner_1: Shackled prevents the use of movement abilities but can be attacked by you or your allies. Destroy it quickly to save your teamates from the slow and damage.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_prisoner_2: Prison Break requires Prisoner to be in range for 3 seconds to achieve his stun. When active, spread out in different directions of the Prisoner to deny him multiple triggers on your team.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_sirbenzingto: Lance-A-Long can deal a large amount of damage at full potential but can also be activated for half damage if you need some quick burst for a finishing blow.
Knightfall is an amazing initiation tool but can also be used defensively. Don't forget to activate your ult when in danger to survive for a few more seconds.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_sirbenzingto: Joust allows Benzington to charge in a line at considerable distances, the ability however has a considerable wind up, try to sidestep to dodge it.
Knightfall can deal alot of damage in a big area, but will also follow the target he chooses. Try to avoid clumping up from the target declared by Benzington.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_circe_1: Doppelgangers have a low mana cost and cooldown. Use them to scout ahead safely or build up an army prior to a fight.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_circe_2: Deceive can be used as both a ganking or escape skill. Take advantage of the invisibility time to setup a good position for your Twisted Visage.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_circe_1: Doppelgangers add alot of damage to a team fight however they are very vulnerable when attacked.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_circe_2: Twisted Visage has a notable link and channel time before Circe can clone the enemy. This can be disrupted by moving out of range or by interrupting Circe.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_shellshock_1: Fireflies can be used to setup ganks with Rolling Thunder, but are just as useful for scouting enemies in fog when you are on the defensive.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_shellshock_2: Allies are invulnerable while inside Rolling Thunder. Rolling at just the right time can save a teammate's life and potentially turn the fight!
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_shellshock_1: Rolling Thunder will follow the target Shellshock chooses, but can be outrun to place him and his allies in a vulnerable position for counter-initiation.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_shellshock_2: Sanctuary Stone can be picked up by his allies after Shellshock's death. Destroy it before this happens to remove any Magic Armor advantage for the opponents!
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_warchief_1: Sacred Totems last for 30 seconds when placed. If you think there is danger nearby, it doesn't hurt to drop them at your feet to setup your defenses ahead of time.
hero_tip_offensive_tip_hero_warchief_2: Spirit Walk is a great initiation tool, but it can also be used for the auxiliary effects of disjointing enemy projectiles or gaining 50% damage reduction while channeling.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_warchief_1: Warchief's ultimate; Warcry is an enormously powerful team buff.  It is however just a buff, and may be purged to immediately end the effect for him and his team.
hero_tip_defensive_tip_hero_warchief_2: Warchief's Sacred Totems die in one hit.  The Shock Totem can often be killed before it activates and killing the Life Totem early can deny Warchief a good deal of health.

bot_description_aluna: Aluna is a strong ranged intelligence hero with a high damage nuke that can be global. Authored by Kairus101!
bot_description_arachna: Arachna is a single-target DPS carry with strong harassment capability and low survivability.
bot_description_armadon: Armadon is a tank who excels at dealing area damage and running down enemies. Authored by Sparks1992!
bot_description_balphagore: Balphagore is a melee strength tank with insane pushing potential. Authored by Kairus101!
bot_description_blacksmith: A powerful, luck-based intelligence hero who has a nuke with a high damage cap! Authored by Kormoranos!
bot_description_blood_hunter: Blood Hunter is a capable carry who relies on his spells to disable and lockdown his prey. Authored by ModernSaint!
bot_description_bombardier: Bombardier is a ranged intelligence hero with strong magic damage spells. Authored by Anakonda!
bot_description_bushwack: Bushwack is a highly mobile, short ranged carry who excels in kiting his enemies. Authored by `IceCube`!
bot_description_chronos: Chronos is a strong late game carry. Although weak early on, he can become very deadly and elusive later.
bot_description_dampeer: Dampeer is a feared melee ganker early game and an effective carry late game. Authored by DildoSamuri!
bot_description_defiler: Defiler is a team-oriented lane pusher with a dangerous ultimate. Her spells pack a punch!
bot_description_dr_repulsor: Doctor Repulsor is an incredibly mobile ganker with loads of magic damage. Authored by EyeOneTwoDye!
bot_description_ellonia: Ellonia is a ranged intelligence hero with powerful, icy skill shots! Authored by Mellow_Ink!
bot_description_emerald_warden: Emerald Warden is a ranged Agility hero with a simple kit meant for beginners. Authored by Sparks1992!
bot_description_engineer: A capable ganker, Engineer also provides a lot of teamfight capability. Authored by V1P3R`!
bot_description_flint_beastwood: Flint Beastwood is a late-game DPS carry and consummate sniper, with a very long attack range.
bot_description_forsaken_archer: Forsaken Archer is a carry with a good mix of both Physical and Magic damage.
bot_description_glacius: Glacius is a support hero with strong spells, including a global mana regeneration aura.
bot_description_gravekeeper: Gravekeeper is a versatile hero with solid Magic and Physical damage. Authored by Schnarchnase!
bot_description_grinex: Grinex is a fast melee ganker whose stealth makes him a slippery foe. Authored by Darkfire!
bot_description_gunblade: Gunblade is a agile carry, able to deal severe damage at close range. Authored by ModernSaint!
bot_description_hammerstorm: With one of the best stuns in the game, Hammerstorm is a very reliable physical hero.
bot_description_legionnaire: Legionnaire is a jungling tank who punishes attackers. A collaboration by Rinestone, DarkFire and Kairus101!
bot_description_magebane: Magebane is quick, mobile melee carry with manaburn and blink. Authored by Pure`Light!
bot_description_magmar: Magmus is one of the most effective gankers and initiators in the game if played well.
bot_description_maliken: Maliken is a hard-hitting strength carry whose ult can dominate a teamfight. Authored by Kairus101!
bot_description_midas: Midas is a hard-to-kill strength nuker with high survivability and enough gold to make him escape any situation. Authored by Sparks1992!
bot_description_moon_queen: Moon Queen is a short-ranged carry with strong ganking and a deadly ult. Authored by Anakonda!
bot_description_myrmidon: Myrmidon is a ranged support hero, with great crowd control. A collaboration by VHD, DarkFire and Kairus101!
bot_description_pandanomium: Pandamonium is a carry hero with amazing disable abilities and Face Smashing techniques. Authored by Sparks1992!
bot_description_parasite: A jungling bot who has very large burst damage output. A collaboration by Mellow_Ink and Kairus101!
bot_description_plague_rider: Plague Rider is support with strong magic damage. Authored by CASHBALLER!
bot_description_predator: Predator is a carry strength hero who is known for his survivability and damage potential.
bot_description_prisoner: Prisoner is a bruiser hero that pulls enemies to him & keep them there as long as possible. Authored by Sparks1992!
bot_description_pyromancer: Pyromancer is a nuker of the highest caliber. Catch this! Authored by CuvelClark!
bot_description_ra: Amun-Ra serves as a pusher and mid-game carry that works well in most lanes. Authored by St0l3n_ID!
bot_description_ravenor: Ravenor is strength carry whose attacks are imbued with heavy magic damage. Authored by tchackie!
bot_description_revenant: Revenant is a ganker who lowers armor while adding magical damage to allies. Authored by Rinestone!
bot_description_rhapsody: Rhapsody is a support hero with pushing ability and a damage-absorbing ult. Authored by fane_maciuca!
bot_description_shadowblade: Shadowblade is a unique hero that can be played in all roles by changing his main attribute. Authored by Sparks1992!
bot_description_shaman: Demented Shaman is a deadly support whose spells have both offensive and defensive components.
bot_description_soul_reaper: Soul Reaper is a strong, versatile hero who can heal, harm, and execute! Authored by paradox870!
bot_description_succubus: Succubus is a good disabler with high spell damage. Authored by Anakonda!
bot_description_witch_slayer: Witch Slayer is one of the most reliable support heroes, with two different controlling abilities.
bot_description_wretched_hag: Wretched Hag is a mobile ganker and semicarry who excels in AoE magic damage. Authored by DarkFire!

season_tour_index_intro_snd: Welcome to the Codex, my friend! Many exclusive rewards await, and you can watch our top eSports players compete live!
season_tour_index_about_codex: Welcome, warriors of Newerth! An extraterrestrial force of light and creation called The Ascension is spreading across the galaxies trying to stop Parallax and the Artificers from destroying planets. Newerth is the first planet that has put up a fight against the Artificers long enough for this force of light to arrive.  With the arrival of The Ascension, we are honored to present the Codex to you! Many exclusive rewards await, and you can watch top eSports matches live!
season_tour_index_matches: The war between light and dark is far from over, and we need your help as the battle reaches new heights of intensity! Your participation will decide the fate of Newerth, so don't hesitate to join the fight and boost the power of HoN Codex: The Ascension.  The Codex grants exclusive access to live streams of every World Finals match, and you can support favorite teams with silver coins and earn rewards!
season_tour_index_epicenter: The extraterrestrial Epicenter is the focal point of The Ascension's power, a staggering force of pure light and creation that Newerth has never seen before. When you participate in the Codex, your Epicenter will appear in the Forests of Caldavar and will be upgraded and generate new items to show your level of achievement in The Ascension.
season_tour_index_treasure: Your Epicenter will also generate Glimmers, extraterrestrial tokens that can be contributed to The Ascension in return for exclusive items.  In the coming months, after each matchmaking game you will have a chance to earn Glimmers. Gather them and gain access to the precious Codex Treasures!

tut_dialog1: ???:  It is time, Hero, you are needed once again.
tut_dialog2: ???:  Beware, trouble lurks around these lands.
tut_dialog3: Hammerstorm:  Wh... Who are you? What is this place?
tut_dialog5: Jereziah:  Welcome new recruit, time is of the essence, let us get started quickly.
tut_dialog6: Jereziah:  This is the world tree, its why we are here. This tree is the essence of life gifted by Sol to the men and beasts of the Earth. If it dies, so does man.
tut_dialog7: Jereziah:  I will die to protect this tree, and now that you are here....you will too.
tut_dialog8: Jereziah:  Apex has setup a forward base..  where his hoards of demons will march upon our lands. He is dead set at destroying this world and everything that lives upon it.
tut_dialog9: Jereziah:  He summons these abominations from the depths of hell at this Sacrificial Shrine. If we destroy it, than we halt the invasion and save our world.....Now lets show you the ropes.
tut_dialog10: Jereziah:  Alright send this monstrosity back to the pits it crawled out of.
tut_dialog11: Jereziah:  Well we didn't recruit you because of your looks, Pyro....You are capable of so many things. You are tapped into the world of magic and you can harness the power of fire. Burn these beasts to ash!.
tut_dialog12: Jereziah:  Good....you're learning. Now take down this thing we found in the jungle last night...We cant put it down unless you stun it out of its blood lust.
tut_dialog13: Jereziah:  Excellent. I think you're ready for the front
tut_dialog14: Jereziah:  Come over here and lets get started...
tut_dialog15: Jereziah:  Good! Here is the fountain. It has been blessed by Sol and will heal you whenever you need it. Here at this fountain you are safe from your enemies and you can purchase items to enhance your capabilities out on the battlefield.
tut_dialog16: Jereziah:  In order to get to the front line your going to need some speed. Go into the shop and buy some marchers, that should help.
tut_dialog17: Jereziah:  Good, now that you can move around quicker lets make our way to the front line.
tut_dialog18: Jereziah:  Oh great, looks like the fight has started without us..Marchers wont get you there quick enough.. Quick buy a homecoming stone from the shop! and use it on the tower.
tut_dialog19: Jereziah:  Good luck kid, your gonna need it.

hero_armadon_description: A stolid and stalwart defender of the weak, whether Man or Beast, the long-lived Armadon refused to take part in the war between the Legion and the Horde, and instead maintained a neutral haven amidst the strife. hero_bushwack_description: In the northeast reaches of the Rulian Marsh exist a tribe that have fought hard for a place to call their own. However there are those who leave the marsh, sometimes by choice, but most times by force. Bushwack is a hunter that has been living on his own for years. Ostracized from his tribe at a young age for tampering with the technology of an abandoned Dwarven village. Considered to be bad voodoo by the tribal elders, such interactions with the strange machinery was not only forbidden but punishable by exile. Bushwack pleaded with the elders saying that it is foolish to not use the power of one of their greatest foes, but his pleas fell on deaf ears. So he parted ways with his people in order to pursue his passions.  Now he is one of the most feared hunters of the southern parts of Death's Cradle, using his troll cunning and dwarven ingenuity, to eliminate foes from great distances. Even though he works alone he is steadfast in the protection of his home and has aligned himself with the Helbourne who are also enemies of the Dwarves. Meeting the Electrician and Dr. Repulsor cemented his belief that the only way for his people to survive in these changing times is through harnessing technology, and leaving the voodoo behind.
hero_bushwack_role: Bushwack is a ranged agility carry who excels at kiting through quick movement and positioning. Between Crippling Dart and Side Step, Bushwack can keep his enemies in range, and Jungle Toxin keeps them from juking away.

hero_calamity_description: Sister Arete of the Sacred Order believed Sol had set her upon a path to be King Jeraziah's Queen and provide him with an heir. When she finally mustered the courage to forsake her vows and present herself to the king, Jeraziah accused her of being a daemon herself, trying to tempt him into the sin that would cast his soul down to be condemned by The Three Judges of All and forever imprisoned by the dragon guardian Sunder. Devastated, Sister Arete gorged on poison and damned her own soul. This is what she wanted. The Three Judges sent her to face Sunder, who hoards the souls within the Vault of All Hells, where she used her mastery of the dark arts to make the fearsome guardian her pet. Now she has become Calamity, breaking open the doors of hell and unleashing an endless stream of tortured souls upon Newerth. But she cares not about this. She will kill every one of Jeraziah's advisors, soldiers—even his savage sister—until only he is left standing, and then she will stand beside him, ruling the Third Corruption together.

hero_deadlift_description: Deadlift was human once, a prisoner of the Hellbourne named Eckol who was forced to turn his fellow prisoners into feed for the Fright Hounds. He had forsaken all hope when his long-lost wife, Reena, appeared next to him--she was next in line for the slaughter. Eckol found hope again, and courage. He fought to save Reena and escape the prison camp just as Calamity shattered Newerth closer to the Third Corruption. Reena was consumed by the spreading evil and pulled into the underworld while Eckol was torn apart by shrapnel and cursed with the power to raise the dead. He gathered the molten scraps of metal and used them to hold his ruined body together, vowing to fill the underworld with souls until he found Reena once again.

hero_deadwood_description: Born of the cruelly tainted lands of Newerth, Deadwood is the undead husk of the first Keeper of the Forest. hero_ellonia_description: Those who hail from the great Frostfields of the north live by one rule: fight or die. The powerful ruler of those harsh lands knew her lands would be next and could not sit idly by while her kingdom fell. hero_flintbeastwood_description: For years, the Beasts told of a twisted man-thing that stalked them through the Rulian marshes, leaving a trail of corpses in his wake. The humans dubbed him "Flint Beastwood" -- playing on his flint-lock firearms and his residence in the Beasts' forests. Fast to draw, fast to kill, fast to laugh about the deed, Flint has now spread his carnage beyond the marshes to wherever he can find the Legion.

Slowly he built himself a suit of the hardest metals known to man, tempering away for years as he honed its infernal machinery in secret. As he soldered the final plate onto himself, he emerged neither man nor machine, but a force of nature itself.

hero_geomancer_description: As the murder, atrocity, and sin intensified during Man's Fall from Light, the primordial Geomancers began to stir deep beneath the surface of the Hivelands. They tunneled toward the suffering with scores of daemons crowding behind, anxious to harvest and feed. "Across the world, great ruptures arose, like sores upon the land. Those left to quiver in the darkness called them gates to Hell. And Hell, from them, emerged." Rithe the Geomancer burst through a sacrificial shrine and was the first to taste the flesh of Moon Queen's brood, and he was the last to return to the depths of the underworld when food and souls became scarce and the agony had quelled. For many years he feasted on the blood and pain of those who had been taken during the First Corruption. When Maliken Grimm, King of Newerth, fled into the wilderness and began his descent into madness, Rithe and the Geomancers stirred once again.
hero_geomancer_role: Geomancer is a ganker and area-of-effect team fighter with a variety of crowd control and disable abilities. However, because of how unreliable his skill shots are, he is best paired with more reliable disablers.

hero_grinex_description: For many years, stories have been told in Newerth of a place where unimaginable creatures live in perpetual darkness known as the Great Rift. Many on Newerth have attempted to commune with this place of power and Valreia the Riftwalker is one of the few who is known to have succeeded. Since the Hellbourne enlisted her help in the war against the Legion, rifts have been opening in various parts of Newerth and a great creature has made its way through. Even in the darkness of the Great Rift, there's terror and this creature known only as Grinex is the embodiment of fear. Trapped in a strange new world, this evil power seeks the Riftwalker, as she represents his only chance to escape from this wretched land. Using the Great Rift's power should not be taken lightly and this mere human has grown arrogant. Her time grows short as Grinex approaches from the shadows!

hero_gunblade_description: All he had known, all he had loved-- killed by the wild beasts. He could hear his own screams echoing in his ears as he dropped to his knees and drew his blade. Driven by madness, he began to carve a cursed symbol into his own flesh. Pain was forgotten and only revenge filled his mind. Soon, the symbol was complete and, bathed in his own rage-filled blood, a bargain was struck. The warrior's wish would be granted. He would be given the power that he so desired and the opportunity to exact his revenge. The now-cursed warrior was given two hell-forged firearms and was reborn as Gunblade, Hell's Ranger. Once a Lawman, now the Sheriff of the Damned.

hero_kenisis_description: The Prophet teaches that energy flows through all things, we must only harness it for ourselves. The mages invoke incantations, the priests call upon gods wicked and just, but for the truly powerful, the power is harnessed from within. These are the Disciples of the Way and among them there is one known for his mastery over all - Kinesis. Let the Hellbourne beware the power of his mind.
hero_kenisis_role: Kinesis is an Intelligence ganker who may also be played as an effective support.  Kinesis initiates by lifting an enemy with Stasis Smash, while the enemy is lifted, he Lifts up trees and creeps around them and when the enemy lands he Launches all of the Lifted units at the target for full damage.  Later in the game, Kinesis is able to survive longer in teamfights due to his Inherent Defense.

hero_kingklout_description: The Benevolent and Merciful King Klout began his epic journey as the leader of a troublesome rabble of goblin pickpockets, but he always knew he was destined for something greater. When he obtained the Allowin Crown and Scepter through sheer cunning, courage, and at great risk to life and limb (not necessarily his), he finally ascended to his rightful status as the greatest and most glorious leader throughout all of Newerth, past, present, and future. Huzzah!
hero_kingklout_role: King Klout is an initiation hero that can be a threat from anywhere on the map. Goblin Toss and Bluster can be used together to stack Conscription quickly with your Auto Attacks. Parade of Power is an amazing threat from anywhere... if you can aim it correctly!

hero_klanx_description: All rejoice! Klanx is here, the most diabolical villain to ever grace the world of Newerth! No other minds can comprehend his genius, and even heroic eyes can barely gaze upon his rugged visage without collapsing in admiration. Forget Tork the Engineer and his inferior intellect and supposed ingenuity. Klanx swaggers across the battlefield equipped with the latest and greatest weaponry—which he built, of course—as well as a full supply of faithful lackeys and goons. Victories are his for the taking, and they should feel lucky to belong to such a stunning force of brilliant destruction.
hero_klanx_role: Klanx is a position based carry with the ability to travel over terrain. His Lackey attacks alongside him dealing significant damage but is also avoidable. With the use of his H.A.W.K. Klanx excels at flanking his enemies from unexpected positions.

hero_lodestone_description: Dr. Repulsor stood back and looked over the creation in his laboratory. The golem made from magnetized stone and steel was complete and ready to be brought to life. The Eldritch runes etched into its frame would hold the creature eternally in place. hero_maliken_description: Once the greatest defender of mankind and lord over the entire Legion, Maliken walked too close to the darkness and was claimed by it.  Now he is nothing more than a slave among the damned -- but his incredible might has only grown in his downfall.  Wielding a damned sword fed by his own damned soul, Maliken is the bane of the very heroes he once led into battle.

Because Hellbourne Zeal makes Maliken attack faster as he loses health, playing Maliken requires the player to carefully manage his survival. A Shrunken Head will increase his survivability greatly.

hero_martyr_description: Few clergy of Sol burn with such brilliance that they may ascend to the highest orders of priesthood. Even fewer dare gift their own souls to the Legion, braving an eternity in damnation so that others may prosper in turn. The few who do earn the forsaken title of the Martyr, wielding a battle-ready relic in one hand and carrying the Codex Solaris in the other. To certain death they march; and some say, with more fervor than those who march towards life.
hero_martyr_role: Martyr is a support hero who's all about brinkmanship. Knowing exactly how much enemies can deal and what you can take and dish out at all times is key to playing a successful Martyr. Unlike some supports, Martyr scales well with tank items, and can be a big threat if left unchecked. A combination of healing, health swing, and protective skills makes Martyr a versatile and dangerous support.

hero_pearl_description: For eons, the Bubble Magi were the greatest defense the Legion had against the Beasts and Demons. When Maliken betrayed the Legion, his agents simultaneously assassinated every Bubble Mage known to the Legion and burned their monasteries to the ground. All of them... save for one lone apprentice who was mistaken for a mere servant and one pet turtle who had watched his master from afar. hero_prophet_description: There are those who take a different path to power, one of pacts and binding. These are not the infernal pacts of the Deamons, but instead they are made with the forces that oppose the chaos the Hellbourne bring. The creatures of the world and the forces of life, death, and nature themselves all wish to have their say in the fate of Newerth. To ensure the Hellbourne are driven back into the pits from which they spawned, each will empower an avatar to fight on their behalf, a Prophet to ensure that fate favors the bold. Although the pacts started out as noble, the Prophet did not realize that Raven is a trickster and his pacts come at a cost. The power that the Prophet wielded was more than any one man should taste, and soon he craved more. The only way to achieve such levels of power was the sacrifice of others and when the Legion discovered this wickedness, the Prophet was marked for retribution. He escaped to join the ranks of the Hellbourne where his prophecies can be cast without regard for life or morality.
hero_prophet_role: Prophet is an extremely versatile ranged intelligence hero. His strengths lay in his early laning harassment as well as his teamfight presence. A well placed Shared Fate can alter any teamfight in Prophet's Favor!

hero_riptide_description: The creature known as Riptide was the finest captain of the Legion's Armada, and any who questioned her ability due to gender would find it hard to continue their insults with a slit throat. Her ship, The Mermaid's Wrath, was sailing upon calm waters when the sea began to swirl and churn. The Maw was hungry. The Mermaid's Wrath and her entire crew were lost to the whirlpool, and as soon as the top castle disappeared the waters returned to serenity. But below the surface, these fine sailors and their captain were just beginning the endless torture of The Maw. Their lungs were filled with its icy waters, which had a terrible, undeniable consciousness, and their bodies were broken, battered, and reformed in the undertow. When the Second Corruption occurred and all of Newerth shook, The Maw released Riptide to serve as a protector of the deep, imbued with additional strength whenever she feels the cold comfort of water, and to deliver the most skilled warriors of Newerth back to the abyss. If the shape-shifting Riptide is any indication of what will become of them, it is best for everyone to stay out of the river.

hero_shaman_description: No greater shame has the Beast Horde than the Demented Shaman: one of their holiest priests, an initiate into their deepest secrets and greatest lore, who betrayed his people and turned to join the Hellbourne.  He is a force of corruption and outrage, draining the life of the land to heal those who would destroy it and defeat those who would defend it.

hero_silhouette_description: An orphaned child, Silhouette trained in the Hidden Village of the Scout, working hard towards her goal to become the greatest assassin in Newerth. Unlike her fellow scouts, she was loud, boisterous, and most of all, simply not stealthy. Yet what she lacked in subtlety was made up for with heart, attitude, and the ability to conjure a perfect mirror image of herself. Believe it!
hero_silhouette_role: Silhouette is a skill-shot based carry that is highly dependent on player finesse and control. Nevertheless, she is especially deadly to enemy melee and support, who she can pick off quickly with the burst damage from Relentless Salvo. Her hallmark ability Shadow allows her to create a nearly indistinguishable image of herself.

hero_sirbenzington_description: The beavrels are a proud species, fiercely protective of their territory. Dangerous enough with tooth and tail, they have adapted to the daemon threat by forming the Lancer Brotherhood, led by the fearless Sir Benzington upon his loyal fearet Balric. His righteous lance was crafted for one purpose: piercing the very heart of the Hellbourne.
hero_sirbenzington_role: Nimble and deadly, Benzington is a highly mobile melee ganking hero that also gains increased attack range. Knightfall and Joust allows for engagements at incredible distances making Benzington an intimidating force anytime an enemy is spotted.

After 1.5 seconds of chasing, or if the Mousetrap comes within 60 units of the target being chased, the Mousetrap will explode, dealing ^o{80,105,130,155} Magic Damage^* to all enemies in a 250 radius and ^oStunning them for {1.25,1.5,1.75,2} seconds.^*  Mousetraps move at 350 Movement Speed and give 300 day and night vision. ability_skrap4_description: Did you hear that terrifying howl? It sounded like Vorax, the monster that Skrap has trained to do his bidding.
ability_skrap4_impact_effect: Summons Vorax in a selected lane. Vorax spawns with ^o{100,120,140} Attack Damage^*, ^o{2000,3500,5000} Health^*, ^o10 Armor^*, and ^o10 Magic Armor^* at the lane's creep spawn location, moving at the same speed as his lane creeps down the lane. Vorax appears on the mini-map to both teams, and provides 200 day and night vision to both allies and enemies.  Vorax will attack any enemy that comes within 150 units, but will otherwise disregard attacks against him. Every 10 seconds, Vorax uses Rock Smash to throw a boulder at the furthest enemy hero, dealing Vorax's current attack damage and applying a ^otapering 75% Movement Speed Slow^* for 2 seconds. Vorax gives {100,150,200} gold and {100,150,200} experience when slain, but none if he kills himself. More than one Vorax cannot be active at the same time per Skrap. Skrap only gains 65% Gold Bounty when Vorax kills a creep & is more than 1500 units away from Vorax.

hero_skrap_role: Skrap is a support hero who is capable of pushing lanes with the help of his monster, Vorax. His long-range abilities help him stay behind the front line while harassing enemy heroes and destroying their towers.
hero_skrap_description: Skrap is a cunning scavenger from the Seradati Plains who once roamed the desolate landscape gathering carrion to feed himself and occasionally sell in the rare event he encountered another living thing. Now he hoards every daemon carcass he can find to nourish his destructive, ravenous pet Vorax in the war against the Hellbourne. Skrap prefers to skulk along the edges of combat, harassing the enemy and harvesting their remains until he has enough to feed the Vorax, who revels in charging forward and demolishing everything in its path.

hero_solstice_description: Among the tribes of the moon, there lives an elite caste of warriors. Like Krixi, the Moon Queen, these women draw their power from the rays of Lunari. As children of the Moon Goddess, the rays of Sol burn their flesh, forcing them to construct a vessel to channel Lunari's might during the day. The magicks used were so potent that only a chosen warrior, born in perfect balance between light and darkness, could harness its vast power by being forever bonded to her armor. In the night, the chosen can retake her true form and strike from the shadows, free from her confining shell. Be it through strength by day or stealth by night, Solstice, the Lady of Lunari, stands ready to show her enemies what power truly is.
hero_solstice_role: Solstice changes her role from a more tanky, team-fight presence during the day, to an agile ganker during the night. Look for ways to set up your ultimate from outside of enemy's vision range in order to deal the maximum damage!

hero_soulstealer_description: The priests tell young men bound for the battlefield that if they fall, Elysian fields and peace awaits them. But this is not strictly true, not as long as the Soulstealer walks the battlefield. Gathering the spirits of those he kills in a bloody, shadowy sack, he augments his own power with their suffering.  Those who see him quake in terror to know that death, for them, will be no release, but only a fiery captivity and oblivion.
hero_soulstealer_role: Soulstealer is one of the most rounded heroes in the game, featuring mana-efficient but damaging magical spells but also high Physical Damage. Soulstealer's only weaknesses are a lack of survivability and mobility, but these can be remedied by amassing wealth.

hero_tarot_description: For centuries, the Ageless Oracle has been reborn at the peak of conflict to serve as the voice of the gods and share her visions with the mortals, but to never interfere.  Reborn after the Beast Bone Years as Tarot, a fortune teller who travels with her caravan of gypsies through the ravaged Forests of Caldavar, she foresaw the downfall of Maliken Grimm and the opening of The Scar but was powerless to stop it.  Now Tarot has visions of the destruction of the World Tree, and with full awareness of the doomed future of Newerth she cannot continue with mere divination. She must join the fight against the Hellbourne and tip fate, wavering on the precarious tip of destruction, toward life.
hero_tarot_role: Tarot is an incredibly hard carry that scales into the late game better than almost anyone else. Luck of the Draw is her crowning jewel, allowing her to hit tremendously hard as the game goes on. Her other abilities give her control of a fight while giving her an advantage when solo against 2 opponents.

hero_valkyrie_description: The ancient sagas of the heathen north have long told to the tale of the battle-women known as Valkyries.  For centuries, their ranks have thinned as the old ways have died out and civilization stretched its smothering hand over the frozen wilds.  But some Valkyries still remain, cold and swift as the north wind, wielding their lances with expertise to rival the most veteran Legion warriors.
hero_valkyrie_role: Valkyrie's suite of skills affords her great flexibility in role. With high survivability, good damage output, and great team synergy, she is able to roam, gank, and farm all at the same time.

hero_vanya_description: Wielding twin, scythe-like blades, the she-reaper known as the Dark Lady has moved through the Legion's ranks like a shadow of death.  For soldiers seeking to buck up their courage, she is a punch-line: "Careful you don't find the Dark Lady," they joke to their carousing friend.  But even these jokes are accompanied by a shudder.  Swift and cold and lethal as the frozen winds off the steps, black as the cloud-choked night, she is no laughing matter.
hero_vanya_role: The Dark Lady is a late game powerhouse with an exponential power growth, but is highly dependent on proper early and mid-game support. Once she has amassed enough wealth, her Dark Blades and Charging Strikes allow her to burst down entire waves of enemies.

hero_yogi_description: Is the mighty Wildsoul a Beast who dreamed himself a Man, or a Man who dreamed himself a Beast?  As much a bear as a human, this druidic warrior draws upon primordial woodland energies to strengthen himself and crush those who threaten the natural life of Newerth.
hero_yogi_role: Wildsoul is effective in both the lane and the jungle. He can Summon Booboo to provide himself a permanent companion capable of using items. To this effect, he is two heroes in one.

ability_zephyr4_description: Zephyr creates a mighty Typhoon, slowing Movement Speed and dealing damage to any units near it. The closer an enemy is to the center of the Typhoon, the higher the damage and speed reduction becomes. Grants 600 day and night Clearvision while active.

hero_zephyr_description: A riddler, a sage, and a lover of sweets, Zephyr sadly is known in these times simply as a warrior of the winds.  Though he chose not to participate in the Beast Horde's war with the humans, he has joined battle against the Hellbourne, and the powerful winds and aerial attacks he calls down upon the daemons are a welcome addition to the new Legion.
hero_zephyr_role: Zephyr's damage output comes entirely through his maintenance of Cyclones, so Zephyr's sole imperative throughout much of the game is to build as much survivability as possible through farming. In a team fight, his Gust and Typhoon can disrupt an entire team.
ability_pyromancertutorial1_description: Pyromancer sends forth a phoenix that damages enemies in a line.
ability_pyromancertutorial1_description_: Target a position to shoot out a wave of fire in that direction which deals ^o{100,170,240,310} Magic Damage^* to enemies it passes through.
ability_pyromancertutorial1_impact_effec: Deals {100,170,240,310} Magic Damage to each target in a line.
ability_pyromancertutorial2_description: Pyromancer conjures a mighty elemental fire dragon at a target location, damaging and stunning enemies in an area.
ability_pyromancertutorial2_description_: Target a position to deal ^o{90,150,210,280} Magic Damage^* and apply a ^o1.6 second Stun^* to enemies in the radius.
ability_pyromancertutorial2_impact_effec: Deals {90,150,210,280} Magic Damage and Stuns each target in the radius for 1.6 seconds.
ability_pyromancertutorial2_tooltip_flav: Mana Cost? Check. Cooldown? Check The ability to summon a dragon?  Priceless.
ability_pyromancertutorial3_description: Learning to control the fire within, Pyromancer increases his cast, attack, and Movement Speed after casting while at the same time catching anything he hits with spells or attacks on fire for a short time.
ability_pyromancertutorial3_description_: Passively gives ^o{10,20,30,40} Cast Speed^*. Also causes Pyromancer's attacks and abilities to apply a stacking ^o{1,2,3,4} Magic Damage per second^* to enemies and buildings he damages.
ability_pyromancertutorial3_impact_effec: Your attacks and abilities apply a stack of Burning! for 3 seconds. Burning! can be applied to buildings.  Illusions apply a charge of Burning! every 3 attacks.

ability_pyromancertutorial4_description: Using power granted from Sol, Pyromancer hurls a blazing hot fireball at a target enemy, dealing massive damage.
ability_pyromancertutorial4_description2: ^gThis ability can be boosted by Staff of the Master.^*  ^gStaff Effect:^* Increases damage from {450,675,950} to {650,875,1150}. Upon killing the target, deals 50% of the damage in a 600 radius area.

ability_pyromancertutorial4_tooltip_flav: It's kinda like pitching a baseball. Of fire.
hero_pyromancertutorial_description: For centuries, the Sacred Order has recognized the "Flame-Touched," those men and women filled with a burning, if more than slightly mad, devotion to Sol.  Those Flame-Touched who serve in the Legion are more commonly called Pyromancers for their mastery over fire, and creatures strongly attuned to that element.
hero_pyromancertutorial_role: The Pyromancer is a spike Magic Damage dealer that can incinerate an enemy within seconds by using his three damage spells in quick succession. Because his Dragonfire Stun is delayed on cast, he is best paired with another hero with a ranged Stun.
item_acolytesstaff_shop_flavor: As a student of the hidden forces of Newerth ascends in rank, he is awarded an Acolyte's Staff. By augmenting the acolyte's already impressive mental prowess, the crystalline staff is meant to open the way to the final secrets and eventual masterhood. In these times of strife, however, the staffs have found their way into many bloody and untutored hands.
item_alacrityband_shop_flavor: Alacrity Bands were conjured by The Divine Coterie as a means to quicken their tumbling, juggling, and stage combat in order to further impress their audiences. They didn't care if the crowd was made of peasants or nobles -- they just wanted to put on an amazing show. When a half-drunk and superstitious baron accused them of witchcraft for possessing such agility and ordered them burned at the stake, the performers found another purpose for the Alacrity Bands: defending oneself and attacking one's assailant with a stunning level of speed and zeal. It was a short matter of time before the accessories were carried into battle, and the mass graves began to fill faster than ever.
item_apprenticesrobe_shop_flavor: Apprentice's Robes are ornamented with mystic runes that help remind the wearer of certain important rituals and thus lend him the air of greater intelligence than he may personally possess."\t
item_armorofthemadmage_description: Passively applies an ^oaura^* to nearby enemies.
item_armorofthemadmage_description_simpl: -Magic Armor Aura Active: gain temporary Armor
item_armorofthemadmage_impact_effect: Activate to ^odispel Debuffs on self^* and gain ^o20 Armor that tapers off over 6 seconds^*.
state_armorofthemadmage_defense_frame_ef: 20 Starting Armor, tapers to 0 over 6 seconds
item_axeofthemalphai_shop_flavor: Favored weapons of one particularly hulking clan of daemons, Axes of the Malphai bestow fantastic strength to those who wield them in battle.  There is little more terrifying than a phalanx of smoldering foes clutching such axes as they march into battle.
item_bastardsword_shop_flavor: Particularly popular among the savage barbarians strong enough to wield two at once, Bastard Swords are common but deadly blades found across Newerth.
item_beastheart_shop_flavor: Ripped from some mighty Beast warrior, Beasthearts are daemonic items that grant greater life to one who bloodies his hands with them.
item_blessedarmband_shop_flavor: Bestowed by King Maliken--before he was corrupted--to his most trusted captains, Bolstering Armbands bestow strength to any who wears them, and a confidence in the righteousness of one's cause.
item_bloodbornemaul_description: When damaged, gains 1 charge for every 10 health lost, up to a max of ^o150 charges^*. Each charge grants ^o1 bonus Damage^* to your attacks against non-structure enemies.  Loses 15 charges per second after 4 seconds of not taking any damage from enemies.  Effects of this item do not stack.
item_bloodbornemaul_description_simple: ^97735 Strength^* Gain Bonus Damage when taking damage.
item_bottle_description: Depletes upon use. Must be filled at the Well or by picking up Runes.
item_bottle_description_simple: Restores Health and Mana over 3 seconds. Recharges at the Well and holds Runes.
item_bottle_shop_flavor: A simple empty bottle that can be filled with healing water or magical runes.
item_bottle_impact_effect: Restores ^o135 Health^* and ^o80 Mana^* on self over ^o3 seconds^*. Dispels upon taking damage.
